a: En lah shiur lemala, aval yesh lah shiur lematta. dei la tema hachi, kayyotze bo lulav en lo shiur, hachi name deen lo shiur kelal?
Vehatnan: lulav sheyyesh bo shelosha tefachim kede lenanea bo – kasher, ella: en lo shiur lemala, aval yesh lo shiur lematta; hachi name en lo shiur lemala, aval yesh lo shiur lematta.
Tanu rabbanan: "tzitzit" – en tzitzit ella anaf, vechen hu omer: "vayyikkacheni betzitzit roshi", veamar abbaye: vetzarich lefaroda ki tzutzita dearmae.
Tanu rabbanan: hetil al hakkeren, o al haggedil – keshera. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov (omer) posel bishtehen.
Keman azla ha deamar rav giddel amar rav: tzitzit tzericha shettehe notefet al hakkeren, shenneemar: "al kanfe vigdehem", keman? kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov.
Amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan: vetzarich sheyyarchik melo kesher gudal.
Veitzterich derav pappa, veitzterich derabbi yaakov, dei midderav pappa hava amena: toch shalosh dela layrchek tefe, vechamma dimkarav mealle, itzterich derabbi yaakov.
Vei midderabbi yaakov, hava amena: melo kesher gudal, dela likrav tefe, vechamma derachik mealle, tzericha.

Ravina verav samma havo yatvi kammeh derav ashe, chazyeh rav samma lekarneh diglimeh deravina distar uvetzar mimmelo kesher gudal, amar leh: la savar la mar leha derabbi yaakov? amar leh: bishat asiyyay ittemar.
Ikkesif, amar leh rav ashe: la tittekif lach, chad minnayyhu kitre minnan.
Rav acha bar yaakov rame arba, veayef lehu meaf, umeayyel lehu biglima, veavek lehu mevak. kasavar: baenan temanya biglima, ki hechi delehve "gedil" "gedilim" bimkom petil.
Rav yirmeya middifti rame temanya, deinhu shittesar, vela avek lehu. mar bereh deravina aved kedidan.
Rav nachman ashkecheh lerav adda bar ahava rame chute, veka mevarech "laasot tzitzit". amar leh: may "tzitzi" [deka] shamana? hachi amar rav: tzitzit en tzericha beracha.

Ki nach nafsheh derav huna, al rav chisda lemirme derav adderav, umi amar rav: tzitzit en tzarich beracha? veha amar rav yehuda amar rav: minnayin letzitzit begoy shehi pesula, shenneemar: "dabber el bene yisrael veasu lahem tzitzit" – bene yisrael yaasu velo haggoyim yaasu!
Veha may rumeya? amar rav yosef: kasavar rav chisda: kol mitzva shekkeshera begoy – beyisrael en tzarich levarech, kol mitzva sheppesula begoy – beyisrael tzarich levarech.
Uchelala hu? vahare mila dichshera begoy, detanya: ir sheen bah rofe yisrael, veyesh bah rofe armay verofe kuti – yamul armay veal yamul kuti, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: kuti velo armay.
Uveyisrael tzarich levarech, deamar mar: hammal omer: "baruch asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al hammila".
Midde hu tama, ella lerav? rav mifsayl pasel, deittemar: minnayin lemila begoy sheppesula? daru bar pappa mishshemeh derav amar: "veatta et beriti tishmor".
Rabbi yochanan amar: "himmol yimmol", hammal yimmol.
Sukka mesayyay leh, tefillin have teyuveteh.
Hare sukka dichshera begoy, detanya: sukkat goyim, sukkat nashim, sukkat behema, sukkat kutiyyim, sukka mikkol makom – keshera, uvilvad shettehe mesukkechet kehilchatah.

Uveyisrael en tzarich levarech, detanya: haose sukka leatzmo omer: "baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam shehecheyaynu vekiyyemanu vehiggianu lazzeman hazze", ba leshev bah omer: "baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu leshev bassukka", veillu "laasot sukka" la mevarech.
Tefillin teyuveteh, vahare tefillin difsulot begoy, detane rav chinnana bereh derava
b: Mippashruneya: sefer tora, tefillin umezuzot shekketavan min, kuti, goy, eved, ishsha, vekatan, veyisrael meshummad – pesulin, shenneemar: "ukeshartam" "uchetavtam", kol sheyyeshno bikshira yeshno bichtiva, kol sheeno bikshira eno bichtiva.

Uveyisrael en tzarich levarech, dishlach rav chiyyay bereh derav huna mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: al tefillin shel yad omer: "baruch asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehanniach tefillin", al tefillin shel rosh omer: "baruch asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al mitzvat tefillin", veillu "laasot tefillin" la mevarech!

Ella lav hayeynu tama: kol mitzva daasiyyaytah gemar mitzva, kegon mila, af al gav dichshera begoy – beyisrael tzarich levarech, vechol mitzva daasiyyaytah lav gemar mitzva, kegon tefillin, af al gav difsulot begoy – beyisrael eno tzarich levarech.
Uvetzitzit, beha kamippalgi: mar savar chovat tallit hu, umar savar chovat gavra hu.
Amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe: attun hachi matnitu la.
Anan hachi matnenan la, amar rav yehuda amar rav: minnayin letzitzit begoy shekkeshera? shenneemar: "dabber el bene yisrael veasu lahem tzitzit", yaasu lahem acherim.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: asaan min hakkotzim, umin hannimin, umin haggeradin – pesula, min hassisin – keshera.
Ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar: af min hassisin pesula, baenan teviyyay lishmah.

Ketannae: tzippan zahav, o shettala alehen or behema temea – pesulot. or behema tehora – kesherot, veaf al pi shello ibbedan lishman. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af or behema tehora pesulot, ad sheyyeabbeden lishman.

Amar leh abbaye lerav shemuel bar rav yehuda: ha techelta hechi tzavitu la? amar leh: mayytinan dam chillazon vesammanin, veramenan lehu beyora, veshaklinan pureta beveata, vetaaminan lehu beudera, veshadenan lay lehahu beata, vekalenan leh leudera.
Shema minna telat: shema minna teima pesula, ushema minna devaenan tzevia lishmah, ushema minna teima pasla.
Hayeynu teima pesula, hayeynu tzevia lishmah? amar rav ashe: ma taam kaamar – ma taam teima pesula? mishshum devaenan tzevia lishmah.
Ketannae: teima pesula, mishshum shenneemar: "kelil techelet", divre rabbi chanina ben gamliel.
Rabbi yochanan ben dahavay omer: afillu mare sheni shebbah kasher, mishshum shenneemar: "usheni tolaat".
Tanu rabbanan: techelet en lah bedika, veen nikkachat ella min hammumeche. tefillin yesh lahem bedika, veen nikkachin ella min hammumeche. sefarim umezuzot yesh lahen bedika, venikkachin mikkol adam.
Utechelet en lah bedika? veha rav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda badek leh! (siman begeshem) mayyte magbeya gila, umayya deshavlilta, umeme raglayim

a: Ben arbaim yom, vetare la begavvavyyhu meureta vead letzafra. ippered chazutay – pesula, la ippered chazutay – keshera.
Verav adda kammeh derava mishshemeh derav avvira amar: mayyte chamira arkesa disare veafya la begavvevy, ishtannay limalleyuta – keshera, ligriuta – pesula, vesimanaych: shinnuy sheker, shinnuy emet.
May "en lah bedika" name dekaamar? atteima.
Mar mimmishki ayyti techelta bishne rav achay, badkuha bidrav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda, veippered chazutay, bidrav adda, veishtannay limalleyuta.
Sevar lemifsela, amar lehu rav achay: ella ha la techelta hi, vela kala ilan hi, ella shema minna shemuata ahadade ittemar.

Hecha divdakna bidrav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda, la ippered chazutay – keshera; ippered chazutay – badkinan la bidrav adda bachamira arkesa: ishtannay limalleyuta – keshera, ligriuta – pesula. shelachu mittam: shemuata ahadade ittemar.
Rabbi mani dayek vezaven kechumere matneyata, amar leh hahu sava: hachi avud kammae dekammach, veatzlach iskayyhu.
Tanu rabbanan: hallokeach tallit metzuyyetzet min hashshuk, miyyisrael – hare hi bechezkatah, min haggoy, min hattaggar – keshera, min hahedyot – pesula.
Veaf al pi sheamru: en adam rashshay limkor tallit metzuyyetzet legoy ad sheyyattir tzitziyyoteha.
May tama? hacha targimu mishshum zona, rav yehuda amar: shemma yitlavve immo badderech veyahargennu.
Rav yehuda rame techelta lefarzuma deinashe beteh, umevarech kol tzafra "lehitattef batztzitzit".
Midderame, kasavar: mitzvat ase shello hazzeman gerama hu, ammay mevarech kol tzafra vetzafra?
Kerabbi, detanya: tefillin kol zeman shemmannichan mevarech alehen, divre rabbi.
I hachi, kol shata name! rav yehuda inish tzenia hava, vela share leh liglimeh kulleh yoma. umay shena mitztzafra? ki meshanne mikkesut layla lichsut yom.

Tanu rabbanan: hakkol chayyayvin betzitzit, kohanim, leviyyim veyisreelim, gerim, nashim vaavadim. rabbi shimon poter benashim, mippene shemmitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama hu, vechol mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama nashim peturot.
Amar mar: hakkol chayyayvin betzitzit, kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim. peshita, dei kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim petiri, man lichayyayv?

Kohanim itztericha leh, salka datach amena: hoil uchetiv "lo tilbash shaatnez tzemer ufishtim yachdav. gedilim taase lach", man dela ishteri kilayim legabbeh bilvisha hu demichayyayv betzitzit, hane kohanim hoil veishteri kilayim legabbayyhu – la lichayyeyvu.
Ka mashma lan: nehi deishteri beiddan avoda, bela iddan avoda la ishteri.
Rabbi shimon poter benashim. may tama derabbi shimon? detanya: "ureitem oto" – perat lichsut layla.
Atta omer: perat lichsut layla, o eno ella perat lichsut some? keshehu omer: "asher techasse bah", hare kesut some amur, ha ma ani mekayyem "ureitem oto"? perat lichsut layla.
Uma raita lerabbot kesut some ulehotzi kesut layla? merabbe ani kesut some sheyyeshnah biriyya etzel acherim, umotzi ani kesut layla sheenah biriyya etzel acherim.
Verabbanan
b: Hay "asher techasse bah" may avdi leh? mibbee lehu lechidtanya: "al arba kanfot kesutecha" – arba velo shalosh.
Atta omer arba velo shalosh, o eno ella arba velo chamesh? keshehu omer "asher techasse bah", hare baalat chamesh amur, uma ani mekayyem "al arba"? arba velo shalosh.
Uma raita lerabbot baalat chamesh ulehotzi baalat shalosh? merabbe ani baalat chamesh, sheyyesh bichlal chamesh arba, umotzi ani baalat shalosh, sheen bichlal shalosh arba.
Verabbi shimon, measher" nafka. verabbanan, "asher" la mashma lehu.

Verabbanan, hay "ureitem oto" may avdi leh? mibbee lehu lechidtanya: "ureitem oto uzechartem", ree mitzva zo uzechor mitzva acheret hatteluya (bo) [bah], veezo zo? zo keriyyat shema, ditnan: meematay korin et shema beshacharit? mishsheyyakkir ben techelet lelavan.

Vetanya iddach: "ureitem oto uzechartem" – ree mitzva zo uzechor mitzva acheret hassemucha lah, veezo zo? zo mitzvat kilayim, dichtiv: "lo tilbash shaatnez tzemer ufishtim yachdav. gedilim taase lach".
Tanya iddach: "ureitem oto uzechartem et kol mitzvot Adonai", kevan shennitchayyev adam bemitzva zo nitchayyev bechol mitzvot kullan, verabbi shimon hi, deamar: mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama hi.
Tanya iddach: "ureitem oto uzechartem et kol mitzvot Adonai", shekula mitzva zo keneged kol hammitzvot kullan.

Vetanya iddach: "ureitem oto uzechartem... vaasitem" – reiyya mevia lide zechira, zechira mevia lide asiyya. verabbi shimon bar yochay omer: kol hazzariz bemitzva zo zoche umekabbel pene shechina. ketiv hacha: "ureitem oto", uchetiv hatam: "et Adonai elohecha tira veoto taavod".

Tanu rabbanan: chavivin yisrael shessibbevan hakkadosh baruch hu bemitzvot, tefillin berashehen utefillin bizrootehen vetzitzit bevigdehen umezuza lefitchehen, vaalehen amar david: "sheva bayyom hillalticha al mishpete tzidkecha".

Uveshaa shennichnas david levet hammerchatz veraa atzmo omed arom, amar: oy li sheeemod arom belo mitzva! vechevan shennizkar bammila shebbivsaro, nityayshsheva dato. leachar sheyyatza, amar aleha shira, shenneemar: "lamnatztzeach al hashsheminit mizmor ledavid", al mila shennittena bashshemini.

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: kol sheyyesh lo tefillin berosho utefillin bizroo vetzitzit bevigdo umezuza befitcho, hakkol bechizzuk shello yecheta, shenneemar: "vehachut hameshullash lo vimhera yinnatek", veomer: "chone malach Adonai saviv lireav vaychalletzem".

Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: ma nishtanna techelet mikkol mine tzivonin? mippene shehattechelet dome layyam, veyam dome larakia, verakia lechisse hakkavod, shenneemar: "vetachat raglav kemaase livnat hassappir ucheetzem hashshamayim latohar", uchetiv: "kemare even sappir demut kisse".

Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: gadol onsho shel lavan yoter meonsho shel techelet, mashal lema haddavar dome? lemelech basar vadam sheamar lishne avadav, leechad amar: "have li chotam shel tit", uleechad amar: "have li chotam shel zahav", ufashu shenehem velo heviu, eze mehen onsho merubbe? heve omer: ze sheamar lo "have li chotam shel tit" velo hevi.
Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: chayyayv adam levarech mea berachot bechol yom, shenneemar: "veatta yisrael ma Adonai elohecha shoel meimmach".
Rav chiyyay bereh derav avya, beshabbeta uveyome tave, tarach umemalle lehu beisparmake umagde.
Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: chayyayv adam levarech shalosh berachot bechol yom, elu hen: "shello asaani goy", "shello asaani ishsha", "shello asaani bur".
Rav acha bar yaakov shameh livreh dahava ka mevarech "shello asaani bur", amar leh: kulle hay name? amar leh: veella may mevarech? "shello asaani eved"? hayeynu ishsha! eved

a: Zil tefe.
Tanu rabbanan: chillazon ze, gufo dome layyam, uveriyyayto doma ledag, veole echad leshivim shana, uvedamo tzovin techelet, lefichach damav yekarim.
Tanya, amar rabbi natan: en lach kol mitzva kalla shekketuva betora, sheen mattan secharah beolam hazze, velaolam habba eni yodea kamma. tze ulemad mimmitzvat tzitzit.

Maase beadam echad shehaya zahir bemitzvat tzitzit, shama sheyyesh zona bichrakke hayyam shennotelet arba meot zehuvim bischarah, shigger lah arba meot zehuvim vekava lah zeman, keshehiggia zemanno, ba veyashav al happetach.

Nichnesa shifchatah veamra lah: oto adam sheshshigger lich arba meot zehuvim ba veyashav al happetach. amra hi: yikkanes. nichnas, hitztzia lo sheva mittot, shesh shel kesef veachat shel zahav, uven kol achat veachat sullam shel kesef, veelyona shel zahav.

Alta veyashva al gabbe elyona keshehi arumma, veaf hu ala leshev arom kenegdah, bau arba tzitziyyotav vetafchu lo al panav, nishmat veyashav lo al gabbe karka, veaf hi nishmeta veyashva al gabbe karka. amra lo: gappah shel romi, sheeni mannichatcha ad shettomar li ma mum raita bi.

Amar lah: haavoda, shello raiti ishsha yafe kemotech, ella mitzva achat tzivvanu Adonai elohenu vetzitzit shemah, uchetiv bah: "ani Adonai elohechem" shete feamim – ani hu sheatid lippara, vaani hu sheatid leshallem sachar. achshav nidmu alay kearbaa edim.
Amra lo: eni (mannichacha) [mannichatcha] ad shettomar li ma shimcha, uma shem ircha, uma shem rabbecha, uma shem midrashcha sheatta lamed bo tora. katav venatan beyadah.
Amda vechillekah kol nechaseha, shelish lammalchut, ushelish laaniyyim, ushelish natla beyadah, chutz meotan matztzaot.

Uvat levet midrasho shel rabbi chiyyay. amra lo: rabbi, tzavve alay veyaasuni giyyoret. amar lah: bitti, shemma enayich natat beechad min hattalmidim. hotziah ketav miyyadah venatna lo. amar lah: lechi zechi bemikkachich.
Otan matztzaot shehitztzia lo beissur, hitztzia lo behetter. ze mattan secharo baolam hazze, velaolam habba eni yodea kamma.
Amar rav yehuda: tallit sheula, kol sheloshim yom petura min hatztzitzit, mikkan veelach chayyevet.

Tanya name hachi: haddar befunedki beeretz yisrael, vehassocher bayit bechutz laaretz – kol sheloshim yom patur min hammezuza, mikkan veelach chayyayv. aval hassocher bayit beeretz yisrael – ose mezuza lealtar, mishshum yishshuv deeretz yisrael.
Tefilla shel yad enah meakkevet. amar rav chisda: lo shanu ella sheyyesh lo, aval en lo – meakkevet.
Amru lo: amarta? amar lehu: la, ella man delet leh tere mitzvot, chad mitzva name la lebed?! umeikkara may sevar? gezera shemma yifsha.
Amar rav sheshet: kol sheeno manniach tefillin over bishmona ase.
Vechol sheen lo tzitzit bevigdo over bachamishsha ase.
Vechol kohen sheeno ole ladduchan, over bishlosha ase.
Kol sheen lo mezuza befitcho over bishne ase, "uchetavtam" "uchetavtam".
Veamar resh lakish: kol hammanniach tefillin maarich yamim, shenneemar:
b: "Adonai alehem yichyu ulechol bahen chayye ruchi vetachalimeni vehachayeni".
Mishna hassolet vehashshemen en meakkevin et hayyayin, velo hayyayin meakkevan. hammattanot sheal hammizbeach hachitzon en meakkevot zo et zo.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "uminchatam veniskehem" – have mincha, veachar kach have nesachim. rabbi omer: "zevach unesachim" – have zevach, veachar kach have nesachim.
Verabbi name hachtiv "uminchatam veniskehem"? hahu mibbee leminchatam veniskehem" ballayla, uminchatam veniskehem" afillu lemachar.
Verabbanan name, hachtiv "zevach unesachim"? hahu mibbee leh lichdizeri, deamar zeeri: en nesachim mitkaddeshin ella bishchitat hazzevach.
Verabbi name mibbee leh lichdizeri, verabbanan name mibbee lehu leminchatam veniskehem" ballayla, uminchatam veniskehem" afillu lemachar!
Ella, hayeynu tamayyhu derabbanan, dichtiv "ola umincha", verabbi name hachtiv "ola umincha"?

Ella, bevaim im hazzevach dechulle alma la peligi demincha veachar kach nesachim, dehachtiv "ola umincha". ki peligi bevain bifne atzman, rabbanan savri: middevain im hazzevach – mincha veachar kach nesachim, bifne atzman name – mincha veachar kach nesachim.
Verabbi, hatam hu deayyeyde deatchel baachila, gamar la lecholla milleta daachila, aval bifne atzman – nesachim adifi, hoil demitamra shira alayyhu.
Hammattanot sheal mizbeach hachitzon en meakkevot zo et zo.
Tanu rabbanan: minnayin lechol hannittanin al mizbeach hachitzon shennetanan bemattana achat shekkipper? shenneemar: "vedam zevachecha yishshafech al mizbach Adonai elohecha".

Mishna happarim vehaelim vehakkevasim vehasseirim – enan meakkevin ze et ze. rabbi shimon omer: im hayu lahem parim merubbim, velo hayu lahem nesachim – yavi par echad unesachim, velo yakrivu kullam belo nesachim.
Gemara hane parim uchevasim dehecha? illema dechag – "kammishpat", "kemishpatam" ketiv behu!
Ella derosh chodesh vaatzeret dechomesh happekudim.

a: Elim dehecha? i dehanhu – deayil hu, i daatzeret detorat kohanim – havaya ketiv behu.
Leolam daatzeret detorat kohanim, vehachi kaamar: la elim detorat kohanim meakkevi leh leayil dechomesh happekudim, valo ayil dechomesh happekudim meakkev lehu leelim detorat kohanim.
Ella, parim – daafillu ahadade la meakkevi, veelim – dehacha udehacha hu dela meakkevi, inhu meakkevi.
Tanna mille mille katane.
"Uveyom hachodesh (tikkach) par ben bakar tamim veshishsha kevasim vaayil temimim yihyu", "par" – ma talmud lomar?
Lefi shenneemar battora "parim", uminnayin sheim lo matza shenayim mevi echad? talmud lomar "par".
"Shishsha kevasim" – ma talmud lomar? lefi shekkatuv battora "shiva", uminnayin sheim lo matza shiva yavi shishsha? talmud lomar "shishsha".
Uminnayin sheim lo matza shishsha, yavi chamishsha, chamishsha yavi arbaa, arbaa yavi shelosha, shelosha yavi shenayim, vaafillu echad? talmud lomar "velakkevasim kaasher tassig yado".
Umeachar dichtiv hachi, "shishsha kevasim" lema li? dechamma deefshar lehaddore, mehadderinan.
Uminnayin (leelim shebbetorat kohanim) shemmeakkevin ze et ze? talmud lomar "yihyu".
"Ko amar Adonai elohim barishon beechad lachodesh tikkach par ben bakar tamim vechitteta et hammikdash". "chattat" – ola hi! amar rabbi yochanan: parasha zo eliyyahu atid ledorshah.
Rav ashe amar: milluim hikrivu bime ezra, kederech shehikrivu bime moshe.
Tanya name hachi, rabbi yehuda omer: parasha zo eliyyahu atid ledorshah. amar lo rabbi yose: milluim hikrivu bime ezra, kederech shehikrivu bime moshe. amar lo: tanuach datecha shehinnachta dati.
"Vechol nevela uterefa min haof umin habbehema lo yochlu hakkohanim" – kohanim hu delo yochlu, ha yisrael achli? amar rabbi yochanan: parasha zo eliyyahu atid ledorshah.
Ravina amar: kohanim itzterich leh, salka datach amena: hoil veishteri melika legabbayyhu, tishtere name nevela uterefa, ka mashma lan.
"Vechen taase beshiva vachodesh meish shoge umippeti vechippartem et habbayit", "shiva"?
Amar rabbi yochanan: ellu shiva shevatim shechatu, veaf al pi sheen rubbah shel kahal.
"Chodesh" – im chiddeshu veamru chelev muttar, "meish shoge umippeti" – melammed sheen chayyayvin ella al helem davar im shiggat maase.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: zachur oto haish lattov, vachanina ben chizkiyya shemo, sheilmale hu nignaz sefer yechezkel, shehayu devarav sotrin divre tora. me asa? heela shelosh meot garve shemen, veyashav baaliyyay uderasho.
Amar rabbi shimon: im hayu lahem parim merubbin [vechulei].
Tanu rabbanan: "veefa lappar veefa laayil yaase mincha velakkevasim kaasher tassig yado veshemen hin laefa". amar rabbi shimon: vechi middat parim veelim achat hi?
Ella, sheim hayu lahem parim merubbin velo hayu nesachim – yaviu par echad unesachav, veal yikrevu kullan belo nesachim. veim hayu lahem
b: Elim merubbin velo haya lahen efatan – yaviu ayil echad veefato, velo yikrevu kullam belo efot.
Mishna happar vehaelim vehakkevasim vehassair – en meakkevin et hallechem, velo hallechem meakkevan.
Hallechem meakkev et hakkevasim, veen hakkevasim meakkevin et hallechem, divre rabbi akiva.

Amar rabbi shimon ben nannas: lo ki, ella hakkevasim meakkevin et hallechem, vehallechem eno meakkev hakkevasim, shekken matzinu keshehayu yisrael bemidbar arbaim shana karvu kevasim belo lechem, af kan yikrevu kevasim belo lechem.
Amar rabbi shimon: halacha kedivre ben nannas, aval en hattaam kidvarav.
Shekkol haamur bechomesh happekudim karev bammidbar, vechol haamur betorat kohanim en karev bammidbar, mishshebbau laaretz karvu ellu vaellu.
Mippene ma ani omer yikrevu kevasim belo lechem? mippene shehakkevashim mattirin et atzman, velo hallechem belo kevasim – sheen lo mi yattirennu.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "vehikravtem al hallechem" – chova al hallechem, "shivat kevasim temimim" – af al pi sheen lechem.
Im ken, ma talmud lomar "al hallechem"? melammed shello nitchayyeyvu bakkevasim kodem shennitchayyeyvu ballechem, divre rabbi tarfon.

Rabbi akiva omer: yachol hen hen kevasim haamurim kan hen hen kevasim haamurim bechomesh happekudim? amarta, kesheatta maggia etzel parim veelim enan hen, ella hallalu bain biglal atzman, vehallalu bain biglal lechem.
Nimtza, ma sheamur bechomesh happekudim – karev bammidbar, uma sheamur betorat kohanim – lo karev bammidbar.
Vedilma parim veelim lav inhu, ha kevasim inhu ninhu? middehane ishtanno, hane name deacharine.
Ufarim veelim, mimmay deishtanno? dilma hachi kaamar rachamana: i bae par ushene elim likrav, i bae shene parim veayil echad likrav! middeishtanni sidran, shema minna acharine ninhu.
Hallechem meakkev et hakkevasim, may tama derabbi akiva?
Gamar "yihyu" mittihyena".
Ma lehallan lechem, af kan lechem.
Uven nannas, gamar "yihyu" "yihyu", ma lehallan kevasim, af kan kevasim.
Uven nannas name nelaf mittihyena", ma lehallan lechem af kan lechem? danin "yihyu" miyyihyu", veen danin "yihyu" mittihyena".
May nafka minna? hatana deve rabbi yishmael: "veshav hakkohen" "uva hakkohen" – zehu shiva, zehu bia.
Hane mille hecha delekka dedame leh, aval hecha deikka dedame leh – middedame leh yalfinan.
Verabbi akiva name lelaf "yihyu" miyyihyu"? danin davar shemmattana lakkohen middavar shemmattana lakkohen, leappoke hane deolot ninhu.
Veibbaet ema, bikra gufeh ka mippalgi: "kodesh yihyu laAdonai lakkohen", rabbi akiva savar: e zehu davar shekkullo lakkohen? heve omer: ze lechem.
Uven nannas: mi ketiv "kodesh yihyu lakkohen"?! "kodesh yihyu laAdonai lakkohen" ketiv, ezehu davar shemmiktzato laAdonai umiktzato lakkohen? heve omer: ellu kevasim.
Verabbi akiva, mi ketiv "kodesh yihyu laAdonai velakkohen"? "laAdonai lakkohen" ketiv, kidrav huna, deamar rav huna: kenao hashshem unetano lakkohen.
Amar rabbi yochanan: hakkol modim

a: Sheim huzekku ze laze shemmeakkevin ze et ze. (veeze hu) [veezo hi] zikka shellahen – shechita.
Amar ulla: bau bemareva – tenufa osa zikka, o eno osa zikka?
Peshot leh midderabbi yochanan, deamar rabbi yochanan: shechita osa zikka, mikkelal ditnufa enah osa zikka.
Derabbi yochanan gufa ka mibbaya leh: mifshat peshita leh lerabbi yochanan dishchita osa zikka, utenufa eno osa zikka? o dilma, shechita peshita leh, utenufa mesappeka leh? teku.
Amar leh rabbi yehuda bar chanina lerav huna bereh derav yehoshua: veha ki ketiv "kodesh yihyu laAdonai lakkohen" batar tenufa ketiv, ufeligi ben nannas verabbi akiva.
Velitamaych, batar tenufa vela batar shechita?!
Ella may it lach lememra, meikkara kae, umay "kodesh yihyu laAdonai lakkohen" – davar shessofo lakkohen. hacha name, davar shessofo lakkohen.
Ushechita osa zikka? vrminhi: ad shello shechatah nifras lachmah – yavi lechem acher veshochet.
Mishsheshshechatah nifras lachmah – haddam yizzarek, vehabbasar yeachel, vide nidro lo yatza, vehallechem pasul.
Nizrak haddam, torem min hashshalem al happarus.
Ad shello shechatah yatza lachmah – machnisah veshochet.
Mishsheshshechatah yatza lachmah – haddam yizzarek, vehabbasar yeachel, vide nidro lo yatza, vehallechem pasul. nizrak haddam – torem mimma shebbifnim al shebbachutz.

Ad shello shechatah nitma lachmah – mevi lechem acher veshochet; mishsheshshechatah nitma lachmah – haddam yizzarek, vehabbasar yeachel, vide nidro yatza, shehatztzitz meratztze al hattame, vehallechem pasul.
Nizrak haddam – torem min hattahor al hattame.
Vei salka datach shechita osa zikka, kevan dehuzekku ze laze bishchita, ippesil leh lechem – tippesel name toda.
Shane toda, derachamana karyay "shelamim", ma shelamim kerevim belo lechem, af toda kereva belo lechem.
Amar rabbi yirmeya: im timtza lomar tenufa osa zikka, avad hallechem –
b: Avdu kevasim, avdu kevasim – avad hallechem.
Veim timtza lomar, tenufa enah osa zikka – hevi lechem uchevasim vehunefu, veavad hallechem, vehevi lechem acher – oto hallechem taun tenufa, o eno taun tenufa?
Avdu kevasim – la tibbee lach, devadday bae tenufa; ki tibbee lach – avad hallechem.
Veallibba deven nannas, la tibbee lach, deamar kevasim ikkar. ki tibbee lach allibba derabbi akiva, deamar lechem ikkar – may?
Kevan delechem ikkar – bae tenufa, o dilma kevan demattirin dideh kevasim ninhu – la tzerich tenufa. teku.
Amar leh abbaye lerava: may shena shene kevasim dimkaddeshi lechem umeakkevi, umay shena shiva kevasim ufar veelim dela mekaddeshi lechem vela meakkevi?
Amar leh: hoil vehuzekku ze laze bitnufa. vahare toda delo huzekku ze laze bitnufa, umekaddesha umeakkeva!
Ella, ketoda – ma toda shelamim, af hacha name shelamim.
Mi dame? hatam lekka zevachim acharine bahadeh, hacha deikka zevachim acharine bahadeh – likdeshu hane vehane!
Ella, keel nazir – ma el nazir, af al gav deikka zevachim acharini, shelamim hu dimkaddeshi, midde acharina la, hacha name la shena.

Vehatam menalan? detanya: "veet haayil yaase zevach shelamim laAdonai al sal hammatztzot" – melammed shehassal ba chova laayil, ushechitat ayil mekaddeshan. lefichach, shechato shello lishmo – lo kadasho hallechem.
Tanu rabbanan: shete hallechem habbaot bifne atzman – yunefu, uteubbar tzuratan, veyetzu levet hasserefa.
Ma nafshach? i laachila atyayn – lechlinhu, i lisrefa atyayn – lisrefinhu lealtar, lema lehu ibbur tzura?
Amar rabba: leolam laachila atyayn, gezera shemma yizdammenu lahen kevasim leshana habbaa, veyomru: eshtakad lo achalnu lechem belo kevasim, achshav name nechol.
Veinhu la yadi, deeshtakad la havo kevasim, inhu sharyayn nafshayyhu, hasheta deikka kevasim – kevasim hu desharu lehu.
Amar rabba: mena amena la? ditnan: amar rabbi yehuda: heid ben bucheri beyavne: kol kohen sheshshokel – eno chote.
Amar lo rabban yochanan ben zakkay: lo chi, ella kol kohen sheeno shokel – chote, ella shehakkohanim dorshin mikra ze leatzman:
"Vechol minchat kohen kalil tihye lo teachel". hoil veomer ushete hallechem velechem happanim shellanu hen, heach neechalin?
Hane shete hallechem hechi dame? illema bevaot im hazzevach – attu toda velachmah mi la menaddevi kohanim veachli lehu?
Ella lav bevaot bifne atzman, vekatane: "heach hen neechalin", alma laachila atyayn.

Amar leh abbaye: leolam bevaot im hazzevach, udeka kashya lach mittoda velachmah – lachme toda la ikkeru "mincha", shete hallechem ikkeru "mincha", shenneemar: "behakerivchem mincha chadasha laAdonai".
Rav yosef amar: leolam lisrefa atyayn, vehayeynu tama dela sarfinan – lefi sheen sorfin kadashim beyom tov.
Amar leh abbaye: mi dame? hatam – lav mitzvatan bechach, hacha – demitzvatan bechach, lisrefinhu, midde dehave appar vesair shel yom hakkippurim.

Ella amar rav yosef: gezera shemma yizdammenu lahem kevasim leachar mikkan. amar leh abbaye: tinach kol zeman hakeravatam, levatar hachi lisrefinhu! may "teubbar tzuratan" name dekatane? – tzurat hakeravatam.
Rava amar: laachila atyayn, ugezera mishshum derabba, velav mittameh, ella mikkera.

Veamar rava: mena amena la? dichtiv: "mimmoshvotechem taviu lechem tenufa vegomer bikkurim laAdonai", ma bikkurim bifne atzman, af shete hallechem bifne atzman, uminna: ma bikkurim laachila, af shete hallechem name laachila.

a: Tanu rabbanan: kivse atzeret en mekaddeshin et hallechem ella bishchita.

Ketzad? shechatan lishman, vezarak daman lishman – kadash hallechem. shechatan shello lishman, vezarak daman shello lishman – lo kadash hallechem. shechatan lishman, vezarak daman shello lishman – hallechem kadosh veeno kadosh, divre rabbi. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: leolam eno kadosh ad sheyyishchot lishman veyizrok daman lishman.
May tama derabbi?
Dichtiv "veet haayil yaase zevach shelamim laAdonai al sal hammatztzot", lememra dishchita mekaddesha.
Verabbi elazar berabbi shimon: "yaase" – ad sheyyaase kol asiyyotav.
Verabbi name hachtiv "yaase"? i ketiv "zevach yaase" – kidkaamrat, hasheta dichtiv "yaase zevach" – bema yaase? bizvicha.
Verabbi elazar berabbi shimon, hachtiv "zevach"? hahu mibbee leh lechidrabbi yochanan, deamar rabbi yochanan: hakkol modim shetztzarich sheyyehe lechem bishat shechita.
May "kadosh veeno kadosh"? abbaye amar: kadosh veeno gamur. rava amar: kadosh veeno nittar.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu lemitpas pidyono: leabbaye – la tafes pidyono, lerava – tafes pidyono.
Bishlama lerava, hayeynu deikka ben rabbi lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon. ella leabbaye, may ikka ben rabbi lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon?
Ikka [benayyhu] leippesole beyotze.
Bea minneh rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak merabbi chiyyay bar abba: kivse atzeret sheshshechatan lishman, vezarak daman shello lishman – oto hallechem mahu baachila?
Allibba deman? i allibba derabbi elazar berabbi shimon – haamar zerika hi dimkaddesha! i allibba derabbi – ben leabbaye ben lerava, kadosh veeno nittar hu!

Ella, allibba dehay tanna, detane avu derabbi yirmeya bar abba: shete hallechem sheyyatzu ben shechita lizrika, vezarak daman shel kevasim chutz lizmannan – rabbi eliezer omer: en ballechem mishshum piggul, rabbi akiva omer: yesh ballechem mishshum piggul.
Amar rav sheshet: hane tannae kerabbi sevira lehu, deamar: shechita mekaddesha.
Mihu rabbi eliezer letameh, deamar en zerika moelet layyotze, verabbi akiva letameh, deamar zerika moelet layyotze.
b: Ditnan: emure kadashim kallim sheyyatzu lifne zerikat damim, rabbi eliezer omer: en moalin bahen, veen chayyayvin alehen mishshum piggul venotar vetame.
Rabbi akiva omer: moalin bahen, vechayyayvin alehen mishshum piggul venotar vetame.
May?
Middizrikat piggul kava lelechem befiggul beyotze kevasar, zerika shello lishmah name sharya leh lelechem, o dilma lechumera amrinan, lekulla la amrinan.
Matkef la rav pappa: umimmay dechi itanhu abbaray peligi?
Dilma biditanhu abbaray, dechulle alma la peligi deen zerika moelet layyotze, uvahadar ayyeylinhu peligi, derabbi eliezer savar la kerabbi, deamar: shechita mekaddesha, veippesilu lehu beyotze.
Verabbi akiva kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon, deamar: shechita la mekaddesha, vela mippasli beyotze.
Hay may? i amrat bishlama rabbi akiva kerabbi sevira leh, deamar: shechita mekaddesha lehu, hayeynu dekaamar rabbi akiva dekadshi lehu bishchita, veatya zerika kava lehu befiggul.
Ella i amrat, kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon sevira leh, deamar: zevicha la mekaddesha, zerikat piggul mi mekaddesha?
Vehaamar rav giddel, amar rav: zerikat piggul enah mevia lide meila, veenah motzia mide meila.
Enah mevia lide meila – beemure kadashim kallim.
Veenah motzia mide meila – bivsar kodshe kadashim.
Lav ittotav derav giddel amar rav?
Bea minneh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera: kivse atzeret sheshshechatan lishman, veavad hallechem – mahu sheyyizrok daman shello lishman lehattir basar baachila?
Amar leh: yesh lecha davar sheeno kasher lishmo, vechasher shello lishmo?! vela?! vahare pesach kodem chatzot, deeno kasher lishmo, vechasher shello lishmo!
Hachi ka amena: yesh lach davar shennire lishmo, venidche millishmo, veeno kasher lishmo, vechasher shello lishmo?!
Vela? vahare pesach achar zemanno, bishar yemot hashshana kodem chatzot!
Hachi kaamena: yesh lach davar shennire lishmo, venishchat lishmo, venidche millishmo, veeno kasher lishmo, vechasher shello lishmo?
Vela?! vahare toda!
Shane toda, derachamana karyay "shelamim".
Tanu rabbanan: shachat shene kevasim al arba challot – moshech shetayim mehen umenifan,

a: Vehashshear neechalot befidyon. amruha rabbanan kammeh derav chisda: ha dela kerabbi.
Dei rabbi, kevan deamar shechita mekaddesha, defarek lehu – hecha?
I defarek lehu meabbaray, kevan dichtiv "lifne Adonai", ippesil lehu beyotze. i gavvavy, ha meayyel chullin laazara.
Amar lehu rav chisda: leolam kerabbi, ufarek lehu gavavy, vechullin mimmela ka havvyayn.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: vehatanya, keshehu podan – en podan ella bachutz.
Ha vadday rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi, dei rabbi – ha ippesilu lehu beyotze!

Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: lema tehve teyuveteh derabbi yochanan, miha deittemar: toda sheshshechatah al shemonim challot – chizkiyya amar: kadshu arbaim mittoch shemonim, verabbi yochanan amar: lo kadshu arbaim mittoch shemonim.
Velav mi ittemar ala, amar rabbi zera: hakkol modim hecha deamar "likdeshu arbaim mittoch shemonim" dekadsha, hacha name deamar "likdeshu tarte mittoch arba".
Tane rabbi chanina tirata kammeh derabbi yochanan: shachat arbaa kevasim al shete challot – moshech shenayim mehen, vezorek daman shello lishman.
Sheim i atta omer kach, hifsadta et haacharonim.
Amar lo rabbi yochanan: vechi omer lo leadam "amod vachata bishvil shettizke"?!
Vehatnan: evre chattat shennitarvu beevre ola, rabbi eliezer omer: yuttenu lemala, veroe ani et besar chattat lemala keillu hi etzim, vachachamim omrim: teubbar tzuratan veyetzu levet hasserefa.
Ammay? lema: "amod vachata bishvil shettizke"!
Amod vachata bechattat bishvil shettizke bechattat – amrinan, amod vachata bechattat bishvil shettizke beola – la amrinan.
Uvachada milleta mi amar? veha tanya: kivse atzeret sheshshechatan shello lishman, o sheshshechatan ben lifne zemannan ben leachar zemannan – haddam yizzarek vehabbasar yeachel.
Veim hayta shabbat, lo yizrok. veim zarak – huretza lehaketir emurin laerev.
Veammay? lema: "amod chata bishvil shettizke"!
Amod chata beshabbat kede shettizke beshabbat – amrinan, amod chata beshabbat kede shettizke bachol – la amrinan.

Uvetarte mille la amar? vehatnan: chavit shel teruma shennishbera begat haelyona, uvattachtona chullin temein – mode rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua sheim yachol lehatztzil mimmenna reviit betohora yatztzil.
Veim lav, rabbi eliezer omer:
b: Tered vetittamme, veal yetammeenna bayyad, verabbi yehoshua omer: af yetammeenna bayyad.
Shane hatam, diltumea ka azla.
Ki ata rav yitzchak, tane: kivse atzeret sheshshechatan shello kemitzvatan – pesulin, uteubbar tzuratan, veyetzu levet hasserefa.
Amar rav nachman: mar, demakkesh lehu lechattat – tane pesulin, tana deve levi, degamar shalme chova mishshalme nedava – tane kesherim.
Detane levi: ushear shalme nazir sheshshechatan shello kemitzvatan – kesherin, velo alu labbealim leshem chova, veneechalin leyom valayla, veen teunin lo lechem velo zeroa.
Metivi: asham ben shana vehevi ben shetayim, ben shetayim vehevi ben shana – pesulin, uteubbar tzuratan veyetzu levet hasserefa.
Aval olat nazir, veolat yoledet, veolat metzora, shehayu bene shete shanim, ushechatan – kesherin.
Kelalo shel davar: kol hakkasher beolat nedava – kasher beolat chova, vechol happasul bechattat – pasul beasham, chutz mishshello lishmo.
Hay tanna, tanna deve levi hu.
Ta shema, detane levi: asham nazir vaasham metzora, sheshshechatan shello lishman – kesherim, velo alu labbealim leshum chova.
Shechatan mechussar zeman bivalim, o shehayu bene shete shanim ushechatan – pesulin.
Veim ita, ligmar mishshelamim? shelamim mishshelamim – gamar, asham mishshelamim – la gamar.
Vei gamar shelamim mishshelamim, ligmar name asham measham: asham nazir vaasham metzora measham gezelot vaasham meilot, o asham gezelot vaasham meilot measham nazir vaasham metzora.
Amar rav shimi bar ashe: danin davar shello behechshero middavar shello behechshero, veen danin davar shello behechshero middavar shebbehechshero.
Vela? veha tanya: minnayin leyotze, sheim ala lo yered? shehare yotze kasher bevama.

a: Tena azzot torat haola" ribba semich leh.
Tane rabba bar bar channa kammeh derav: kivse atzeret sheshshechatan leshum elim – kesherin, velo alu labbealim leshum chova. amar leh rav: alu vealu.
Amar rav chisda: mistabbera milleteh derav bichsavur elim, ushechatan leshum kevasim, shehare kevasim leshum kevasim nishchatu.
Aval kesavur elim, ushechatan leshum elim – la. akira betaut havya akira; verabba amar: akira betaut la havya akira.
Amar rava: umotvinan ashshematin, hakkohanim sheppiggelu bammikdash mezidin – chayyayvin, ha shoggin – peturin, vetane ala: piggulan piggul.
Hechi dame? illema deyada dechattat hi, veka mechashshev ba leshum shelamim – hay shoggin?! mezidin havu!
Ella lav dichsavur shelamim hu, veka mechashshev ba leshum shelamim, vekatane: piggulan piggul, alma akira betaut havya akira.
Amar leh abbaye: leolam deyada dechattat hi, veka mechashshev ba leshum shelamim, uveomer "muttar".
Metiv rabbi zera: rabbi shimon omer, kol menachot shennikmetzu shello lishman – kesherot, vealu labbealim leshum chova.
Sheen hammenachot domot lazzevachim, shehakkometz machavat leshum marcheshet – maaseha mochichin aleha shehi machavat, chareva leshum belula – maaseha mochichin aleha shehi chareva.
Aval bizvachim eno ken, shechita achat lechullan, kabbala achat lechullan, zerika achat lechullan.
Hechi dame? illema deyada demachavat hi, veka kametz lah leshum marcheshet – ki maaseha mochichin, may have? ha mikar ka akayr la!
Ella lav dichsavur marcheshet hi, veka kametz lah leshum marcheshet, utea, dehacha hu demaaseha mochichin aleha, ha bealma akira betaut havya akira.
Amar leh abbaye: leolam deyada demachavat hi, veka kametz la leshum marcheshet.
Udeka amrat: ki maaseha mochichin aleha may have? rava letameh, deamar rava: machshava dela minnachra – pesal rachamana, machshava deminnachra – la pesal rachamana.
Mishna hattemidin en meakkevin et hammusafin, velo hammusafin meakkevin et hattemidin, velo hammusafin meakkevin ze et ze. lo hikrivu keves babboker – yakrivu ben haarbayim.
Amar rabbi shimon: ematay? bizman shehayu anusin o shoggin, aval im hayu mezidin velo hikrivu keves babboker – lo yakrivu ben haarbayim.
Lo hiktiru ketoret babboker – yaktiru ben haarbayim.

Amar rabbi shimon: vechullah hayta kereva ben haarbayim, sheen mechannechin et mizbach hazzahav ella biktoret hassammim, velo mizbach haola ella betamid shel shachar, velo et hashshulechan ella belechem happanim beshabbat, velo et hammenora ella beshiva neroteha ben haarbayim.
Gemara bea minneh rabbi chiyyay bar avin merav chisda: tzibbur sheen lahen temidin umusafin, e ze mehen kodem?
Hechi dame? illema temidin deyomeh umusafin deyomeh – peshita temidin adifi, dehavu lehu tadir umekuddash!
Ella, temidin delimchar umusafin dehaiddana – temidin adifi, shekken tadir, o dilma musafin adifi, dehavu lehu mekuddash?
Amar leh, tenetuha: hattemidin en meakkevin et hammusafin, velo hammusafin meakkevin et hattemidin, velo hammusafin meakkevin ze et ze.
Hechi dame? illema deit leh, ulekaddem, vehatanya: minnayin shello yehe davar kodem letamid shel shachar? talmud lomar: "vearach aleha haola".
Veamar rava: "haola" – ola rishona!
b: Ella peshita delet leh! vei deyomeh, ammay? tadir umekuddash – tadir adif!
Ella lav delimchar, vekatane en meakkevin ze et ze, alma ki hadade ninhu.
Amar leh abbaye: leolam deit lehu, ulekaddem. udeka kashya lach shello yehe davar kodem – mitzva bealma hu.
Ta shema: en pochatin mishshishsha telaim hamevukkarin belishkat hattelaim, kede lashshabbat velishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana.
Hechi dame? illema deit leh temidin umusafin – tuva havo!
Ella lav delet leh, ushema minna temidin adifi!
La, leolam deit leh, vehachi ka amar: en pochatin mishshishsha telaim hamevukkarin belishkat hattelaim arbaa yamim kodem shechita, umanni? ben bag bag hi.
Detanya, ben bag bag omer: minnayin letamid shettaun bikkur arbaa yamim kodem shechita? talmud lomar "tishmeru lehakeriv li bemoado", ulehallan hu omer: "vehaya lachem lemishmeret ad arbaa asar yom".
Ma lehallan taun bikkur arbaa yamim kodem shechita, af kan taun bikkur arbaa yamim kodem shechita.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: hane shishsha? shiva havu, deha ikka detzafra ditlata beshabbeta!
Uletamaych, temanya havu, dehaikka defanya demaale shabbeta!
Ha la kashya, dilvatar deakrev kaamar.

a: Mikkol makom shiva havu! ella, tanna bealma kae, umay kede lashshabbat ushene yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana? simana bealma.
Dayka name, dekatane "kede lashshabbat", vela katane "leshabbat velishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana", shema minna.
Lo hikrivu keves babboker vechulei. amar rabbi shimon: vechullah hayta kereva ben haarbayim, sheen mechannechin et mizbach hazzahav ella biktoret hassammim. chinnuch man dechar shemeh?!
Chassore michassera vehachi katane: lo hikrivu keves babboker – lo yakrivu ben haarbayim. bamme devarim amurim? shello nitchannech hammizbeach, aval nitchannech hammizbeach – yakrivu ben haarbayim.
Amar rabbi shimon: ematay? bizman shehayu anusin o shoggin, aval im hayu mezidin – lo hikrivu keves babboker, lo yakrivu ben haarbayim. lo hiktiru ketoret babboker, yaktiru ben haarbayim.
Mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "veet hakkeves hashsheni taase ben haarbayim" – sheni ben haarbayim, velo rishon ben haarbayim.
Bamme devarim amurim? shello nitchannech hammizbeach, aval nitchannech hammizbeach – afillu rishon ben haarbayim.
Amar rabbi shimon: ematay? bizman shehayu anusin o shoggin, aval im hayu mezidin – lo hikrivu keves babboker, lo yakrivu ben haarbayim. lo hiktiru ketoret babboker – yaktiru ben haarbayim.
Vechi chohanim chatu, mizbeach batel?! amar rava: hachi kaamar – lo yakrivu hen, aval acherim yakrivu.
Lo hiktiru ketoret babboker, yaktiru ben haarbayim, dechevan dela shechicha, umeattera, chaviva lehu vela pashi.

Amar rabbi shimon: vechullah hayta kereva ben haarbayim, sheen mechannechin et mizbach hazzahav ella biktoret hassammim shel ben haarbayim vechulei. vehatanya: biktoret hassammim shel shachar! tannae hi.
Amar abbaye: mistabbera keman deamar biktoret hassammim shel ben haarbayim, dichtiv: "babboker babboker behetivo et hannerot yaktirenna".
I lav daavad hadelaka meureta, hatava betzafra mehecha?
Uleman deamar biktoret hassammim shel shachar, gamar mimmizbach haola: ma lehallan betamid shel shachar – af kan biktoret hassammim shel shachar.
Velo et hashshulchan ella belechem happanim beshabbat, ella bechol – ichannoche hu dela michannach, ha kaddoshe meykaddesh?!
Hi gufa ka mashma lan, dechinnuch vekiddush deshulchan beshabbat hu, kidkatane sefa: velo et hammenora ella beshiva neroteha ben haarbayim.
Tanu rabbanan: (zehu) [zohi] ketoret shealta leyachid al mizbeach hachitzon, vehoraat shaa hayta. hecha? amar rav pappa: bannesiim.
Ella yachid al mizbeach hachitzon hu dela, ha al mizbeach happenimi makrev? vetu: al mizbeach hachitzon yachid hu dela, ha tzibbur makrevi?
Vehatanya: yachol yehe yachid mitnaddev umevi keyotze bah nedava, vekore ani bah "motza sefatecha tishmor veasita"? talmud lomar: "lo taalu alav ketoret zara".
Yachol lo yehe yachid mevi, sheen mevi chovato keyotze bah,
b: Aval tzibbur yehe mevi, shemmevi chova keyotze bah, talmud lomar "lo taalu".

Yachol lo yaalu al mizbeach happenimi, aval yaalu al mizbeach hachitzon? talmud lomar: "et shemen hammishcha veet ketoret hassammim lakkodesh kechol asher tzivviticha yaasu" – en lecha ella ma sheamur bainyan.

Amar rav pappa: la mibbaya kaamar, la mibbaya tzibbur al mizbeach hachitzon, dela ashkechan, vela mibbaya yachid al mizbeach happenimi, dela ashkechan, ella afillu yachid al mizbeach hachitzon, deashkechan binsiim – horaat shaa hayta.
Mishna chavitte kohen gadol lo hayu bain chatzain, ella mevi issaron shalem vechotzehu, makriv mechetza babboker umechetza ben haarbayim.

Kohen shemmevi mechetza shacharit, vamet, uminnu kohen acher tachtav – lo yavi chatzi issaron mibbeto vachatzi esrono shel rishon, ella mevi issaron shalem (mechetza) vechotzehu, makriv mechetza umechetza aved. nimtzeu shene chatzain kerevin, ushene chatzain ovdin.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: illu neemar "mincha machatzit", hayiti omer mevi chatzi issaron mibbeto shacharit umakriv, chatzi issaron mibbeto arvit umakriv.
Talmud lomar "machatzitah babboker umachatzitah baarev" – mechetza mishshalem hu makriv, ha ketzad? mevi issaron shalem vechotzehu, umakriv mechetza babboker umechetza ben haarbayim.
Nitma mechetza shel ben haarbayim, o sheavad, yachol yavi chatzi issaron mibbeto arvit veyakriv? talmud lomar "machatzitah babboker umachatzitah baarev" – mechetza mishshalem hu mevi.
Ha ketzad? mevi issaron shalem [mibbeto], vechotzehu, umakriv mechetza, umechetza aved. nimtzeu shene chatzain kerevin, ushene chatzain ovdin.

Kohen gadol shehikriv mechetza shacharit vamet, uminnu acher tachtav, yachol yavi chatzi issaron mibbeto, o chatzi esrono shel rishon? talmud lomar "umachatzitah baarev" – mechetza mishshalem hu mevi umakriv.
Ha ketzad? mevi issaron shalem, vechotzehu, umakriv, umechetza aved. nimtzeu shene chatzain ovdin, ushene chatzain kerevin.
Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman: mechetza rishon umechetza sheni – teubbar tzuratan, veyetzu levet hasserefa.
Amar leh rav nachman: bishlama rishon ichazi lehakerava, ella sheni lema leh ibbur tzura? meikkara leibbud ka ate.
Daamar lach, manni? tanna deve rabba bar avu hu, deamar: afillu piggul taun ibbur tzura.
Rav ashe amar: afillu tema rabbanan, kevan dividdana (defalgi behu) [defalginhu], i bae hay makrev, vei bae hay makrev – michza chazu.
Ittemar: chavitte kohen gadol, ketzad osin otan? rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: ofah, veachar kach metaggenah. rabbi assi amar rabbi chanina: metaggenah, veachar kach ofah.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: kevavteh didi mistabbera, "tufine" – tofenna naa. rabbi assi amar: kevavteh didi mistabbera, "tufine" – tofenna na.
Ketannae: "tufine" – tofenna na. rabbi omer: tofenna naa. rabbi yose omer: tofenna rabba. it leh na, veit leh naa.
Tenan hatam: chavitte kohen gadol – lishatan vaarichatan vaafiyyaytan bifnim, vedochot et hashshabbat.
Mena hane mille? amar rav huna: "tufine" – tofenna naa, vei afe la meetmol – innashfa la. matkef la rav yosef: ema dechavesh leh beyarka!
Deve rabbi yishmael tana: "tease" – vaafillu beshabbat, "tease" – vaafillu betumea.
Abbaye amar: amar kera "solet mincha tamid",

a: Hare hi keminchat temidin.
Rava amar: "al machavat" – melammed shetteuna keli, vei afe la meetmol – ippesila lay belina. tanya kevavteh derava: "al machavat" – melammed shetteuna keli.
"Bashshemen" – lehosif lah shemen, veeni yodea kamma.
Hareni dan: neemar kan "shemen", veneemar lehallan beminchat nesachim "shemen" – ma lehallan sheloshet luggin leissaron, af kan sheloshet luggin leissaron.
O kelach lederech zo: neemar kan "shemen", veneemar beminchat nedava "shemen", ma lehallan log echad, af kan log echad.
Nire lemi dome? danin 711 751: tadir, baa chova, docha shabbat, docha tumea.
Veen danin 711 mishsheeno 711.
O kelach lederech zo: danin 53 93 – yachid, biglal atzmah, yayin, levona.
Veen danin 53, mishsheeno 53.
Rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: "solet mincha tamid" – hare hi lecha keminchat temidin, ma minchat temidin shelosha luggin leissaron, af zo shelosha luggin leissaron.
Rabbi shimon omer: ribba kan shemen, veribba beminchat kevasim shemen, ma lehallan sheloshet luggin leissaron, af kan sheloshet luggin leissaron.
O kelach lederech zo: ribba kan shemen, veribba beminchat parim veelim shemen, ma lehallan shene luggin leissaron, af kan shene luggin leissaron?
Nire lemi dome: danin mincha habbaa issaron, mimmincha habbaa beissaron, veen danin mincha habbaa issaron, mimmincha habbaa shenayim ushelosha esronim.
Ha gufa kashya, amrat "bashshemen" lehosif lah shemen, vahadar tane: neemar kan "shemen", veneemar beminchat nedava "shemen".
Amar abbaye: man tena "bashshemen" lehosif? rabbi shimon hi, veillu lo neemar kaamar. uvedina man ka mahdar? rabbi yishmael.
Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar: kullah rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka hi.
Vehachi kaamar: "bashshemen" – lehosif lah shemen, dei likboa shemen – la tzerich, kevan dichtiv bah "al machavat" – keminchat machavat damya.
O eno ella likboa lah shemen, dei la ketav rachamana "bashshemen", hava amena tehve keminchat chote.
Hadar amar: tihve name likboa lah shemen, tete middina, vedan dina vela atya leh, veatzrecha kera "solet mincha tamid", kedimsayyem rabbi yishmael milleteh.
Rabba amar: kulla rabbi shimon [veillu lo neemar kaamar].
Vehachi kaamar: "bashshemen" lehosif lah shemen, dei likboa lah shemen la tzerich, kevan dichtiv ba "al machavat" kemachavat damya, vead shello yeamer "bashshemen" yesh li baddin.
Vedan dina, la atya leh, veatzrecha "bashshemen", hadar amar: tehve keminchat parim veelim.
Hadar amar: danin
b: Mincha habbaa issaron vechulei.
Mishna lo minnu kohen acher tachtav, mishshel mi hayta kereva? rabbi shimon omer: mishshel tzibbur. rabbi yehuda omer: mishshel yorshin. ushelema hayta kereva.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: kohen gadol shemmet velo minnu kohen acher tachtav, minnayin shettehe minchato kereva mishshel yorshin? talmud lomar: "vehakkohen hammashiach tachtav mibbanav yaase otah".
Yachol yakrivenna chatzain? talmud lomar "otah" – kullah velo chetzyah, divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi shimon omer: "chok olam" – mishshel olam, "kalil toktar" – shettehe kullah behaketara.
Vehay "hakkohen hammashiach" lehachi hu daata?

Hay mibbee leh lechidtanya: "ze korban aharon uvanav asher yakrivu laAdonai beyom himmashach oto", yachol yehu aharon uvanav makrivin korban echad? talmud lomar "asher yakrivu laAdonai", aharon bifne atzmo uvanav bifne atzman. "banav" – ellu kohanim hedyotot.
Atta omer kohanim hedyotot, o eno ella kohanim gedolim? keshehu omer "vehakkohen hammashiach tachtav mibbanav" – hare kohen gadol amur, ha ma ani mekayyem "banav"? ellu kohanim hedyotot.
Im ken lichtov kera "hakkohen hammashiach tachtav banav yaase", may "mibbanav"? shamat minna tarte.
Verabbi shimon, hay "otah" may aved leh? mibbee leh lechohen gadol shemmet uminnu acher tachtav, shello yavi chatzi issaron mibbeto velo chatzi issaron shel rishon.
Vetippok leh min "umachatzitah"? vav la daresh.
Verabbi yehuda, hay "chok olam" may aved leh? chukka leolam tehe.
"Kalil toktar" lema li? mibbee leh lechidtanya: en li ella elyona (minchat kohen gadol) bechalil toktar", vetachtona (minchat kohen hedyot) belo teachel".
Minnayin litten et haamur shel ze baze veet haamur shel ze baze? talmud lomar "kalil" "kalil" ligzera shava, neemar kan "kalil" veneemar lehallan "kalil",
Ma kan bechalil toktar", af lehallan bechalil toktar". uma lehallan litten lo taase al achilato, af kan litten lo taase al achilatah.
Vesavar rabbi shimon mishshel tzibbur deorayyta?

Vehatnan, amar rabbi shimon: shiva devarim hitkinu bet din, veze echad mehen. goy sheshshalach olato mimmedinat hayyam, shalach immah nesachim – (kereva) [kerevin] mishshello, veim lav – kerevin mishshel tzibbur.
Vechen ger shemmet, vehinniach zevachim – yesh lo nesachim kerevin mishshello, veim lav – kerevin mishshel tzibbur.
Utenay bet din hu, kohen gadol shemmet velo minnu kohen acher tachtav, shettehe minchato kereva mishshel tzibbur.
Amar rabbi avahu: (shene) [shete] takkanot havo.
Deorayyta middetzibbur, kevan dachazo deka middachka lishka – takkinu deligbe miyyorshim, kevan dachazo deka fashi ba – okmuha addeorayyta.
Veal para shello yehu moalin beefrah deorayyta hi! detanya: "chattat hi", melammed shemmoalin ba – "hi", bah moalin,

a: Beefrah en moalin.
Amar rav ashe: shete takkanot havay, deorayyta – bah moalin, beefrah en moalin. kevan dachazo deka mezalzeli ba, veka avdi minneh lemakkatan – gezaru beh meila.
Kevan dachazo deka parshi missefek hazzaot, okmuha addeorayyta.
Tanu rabbanan: par helem davar shel tzibbur useire avoda zara – battechilla magbin lahen, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer: mitterumat hallishka hen bain.
Vehatanya ippecha, he minnayyhu achrita?
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav ashe: lema kammayyta achrita, deshaminan leh lerabbi shimon dechayesh lifshia.
Amar lehu rav ashe: afillu tema batrayyta achrita, ki ka chayesh rabbi shimon lifshia – milleta delet behu kappara begavvav, bemilleta deit lehu kappara begavvav – la chayesh rabbi shimon lifshia.
May have ala?

Amar leh rabba zute lerav ashe: ta shema, detanya: "et korbani lachmi leishshay reach nichochi tishmeru lehakeriv li bemoado" – lerabbot par helem davar shel tzibbur useire avoda zara shebbain mitterumat hallishka, divre rabbi shimon.
Ushelema hayta kereva vechulei. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: bae rabbi yochanan – shelema shacharit ushelema ben haarbayim, o dilma shelema shacharit uvetela ben haarbayim?
Amar rava ta shema: shemini bachavittim, veim ita divtela ben haarbayim – ha zimnin dela mashkach leh shemini bachavittim! hechi dame? demet kohen gadol velo minnu acher tachtav.
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derabbi yirmeya, amar: bavlae tafshae, mishshum (deyatvu) [deyatvi] beatra dachashocha amri shematata dimchashshechan.
Ella, dekatane: shevii bassolet, teshii bayyayin, hachi name dela batli?
"Minchatam veniskehem" ballayla, "minchatam veniskehem" afillu lemachar.
Ella, dei la katane; hachi name, dei la katane.
Ahderuha kammeh derava, amar: mibbishutin amri kammayyhu, mittevutin la amri kammayyhu.
Vhadar amar rava: hane name tevutin hi, amar kera: "solet mincha tamid", hare hi lecha keminchat temidin.
May have ala? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ta shema, detanya: shelema shacharit, ushelema ben haarbayim.
Amar rabbi yochanan: peligi ba abba yose ben dostay verabbanan.

Abba yose ben dostay omer: mafrish lah shene kematzim shel levona, kometz shacharit vekometz ben haarbayim. verabbanan amri: mafrish lah kometz echad, chatzi kometz shacharit vachatzi kometz ben haarbayim.
Bemay kamippalgi? abba yose ben dostay savar: la ashkechan chatzi kometz dekarev, verabbanan savri: la ashkechan issaron devae shene kematzim.
Bae rabbi yochanan: kohen gadol shemmet velo minnu acher tachtav,
b: Lerabbanan huchepla levonato, o la? mi amrinan: mittoch shehuchepla solto huchepla levonato, o dilma may degalli galli, may dela galli la galli.
Veshemen, ben leabba yose ben dostay uven lerabbanan – mahu?
Amar rava ta shema: chamishsha kematzin hen, veim ita, zimnin demashkachat la shiva.
Dei la katane, yatev rav pappa vekaamar la leha shemata. amar leh rav yosef bar shemaya lerav pappa: veha maale kometz bachutz, dei hava, vekatane.

May have ala? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ta shema, detanya: kohen gadol shemmet velo minnu acher tachtav – shelema shacharit, ushelema ben haarbayim, umafrish lah shene kematzin – kometz shacharit vekometz ben haarbayim, umafrish lah sheloshet luggin – log umechetza shacharit, log umechetza ben haarbayim.
Manni? illema rabbanan – may shena levonatah dehuchepla, umay shena shamnah delo huchepla?
Ella, abba yose ben dostay hi, deamar: chavitte kohen gadol bealma shene kematzin baaya, ulevona lo huchepla, veshemen lo huchepal.
Umiddeshemen leabba yose ben dostay lo huchepla levonatah veshamnah, lerabbanan name la hucheplu.
Amar rabbi yochanan: halacha keabba yose ben dostay. umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? veha amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kistam mishna, utenan: chamishsha kematzin hen.
Amorae ninhu, veallibba derabbi yochanan.
Hadaran alach hattechelet.
Mishna kol hammenachot baot matztza, chutz mechametz shebbattoda ushete hallechem shehen baot chametz.
Rabbi meir omer: hasseor bode lahen mittochan, umechammetzan.
Rabbi yehuda omer: af hi enah min hammuvechar, ella mevi et hasseor venotno letoch hammidda, umemalle et hammidda. amru lo: af hi hayta chasera o yetera.
Gemara bea minneh rabbi perida merabbi amme: minnayin lechol hammenachot shehen baot matztza? menalan? dichtiv ba – ketiv ba, dela ketiv ba – ketiv ba

a: "Zot torat hammincha hakerev otah bene aharon lifne Adonai el pene hammizbeach. vehannoteret mimmenna yochlu aharon uvanav matztzot teachel". amar leh: mitzva la ka mibbaya li, ki ka mibbaya li leakkev.
Amar leh: leakkev, name ketiv "lo teafe chametz", ella matztza.
Matkef la rav chisda: veema "lo teafe chametz", ella siur.
Siur deman? i derabbi meir – lerabbi yehuda matztza mealleya hi, i derabbi yehuda – lerabbi meir chametz mealleya hu.
I derabbi meir, lerabbi meir – middelake aleh, chametz hu! ella derabbi yehuda, lerabbi yehuda.
Matkef la rav nachman bar yitzchak, veema: "lo teafe chametz" – ella chalut. chalut may nihu? revicha. i deikka revucha – ketiv bah revucha, veha la ketiv bah revucha.
Veema: dichtiv bah revucha – mitzva birvucha, udela ketiv ba revucha – i bae revucha layyte, i bae matztza layyte.
Matkef la ravina, veema: "lo teafe chametz" – lemekam gavra belav bealma, veippesole la mippasla?
Ella menalan? kidtanya: "matztza" – yachol mitzva? talmud lomar "tihye" – hakkatuv kevaah chova.
Bea minna rabbi perida merabbi amme: minnayin lechol hammenachot shennilloshot befoshrin, umeshammeran shello yachamitzu? nilmedenna mippesach, dichtiv "ushemartem et hammatztzot".
Amar leh: begufa ketiv "matztza tihye", hacheyeha.
Veha appekteh leakkev? im ken, lichtov kera "matztza hi", may "tihye"? shamat minna tarte.
Amri leh rabbanan lerabbi perida: rabbi ezra bar bereh derabbi avtolas, dehu asiri lerabbi elazar ben azarya, dehu asiri leezra, kae abbava. amar: may kulle hay?
I bar oryayn hu – yae, i bar oryayn uvar avahan – yae, vei bar avahan vela bar oryayn – ishsha techleh. amaru leh: bar oryayn hu. amar lehu: leul velete.
Chazyeh dahava achira dateh, petach vaamar: "amart laAdonai adonay atta tovati bal alecha", amra keneset yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, hachazek li tova shehodaticha baolam.
Amar lah: "tovati bal alecha" – eni machzik tova ella leavraham yitzchak veyaakov, shehodiuni techilla baolam, shenneemar: "likdoshim asher baaretz hemma veaddire kol cheftzi vam".
Kevan deshameh dekaamar "addir", patach veamar: yavo addir veyippara leaddirim meaddirim beaddirim.

Yavo addir – ze hakkadosh baruch hu, dichtiv: "addir bammarom Adonai". veyippara leaddirim – ellu yisrael, shenneemar: "veaddire kol cheftzi vam". meaddirim – ellu hammitzrim, dichtiv: "tzalalu kaoferet bemayim addirim". beaddirim – ellu mayim, shenneemar: "mikkolot mayim rabbim addirim mishbere yam".
Yavo yadid ben yadid, veyivne yadid leyadid bechelko shel yadid, veyitkapperu bo yedidim.
Yavo yadid – ze shelomo hammelech, dichtiv: "vayyishlach beyad natan hannavi vayyikra shemo yedidyah baavur Adonai".
b: Ben yadid – ze avraham, dichtiv: "me lididi beveti", veyivne yadid – ze bet hammikdash, dichtiv: "ma yedidot mishkenotecha", leyadid – ze hakkadosh baruch hu, dichtiv: "ashira na lididi",
Bechelko shel yadid – ze binyamin, shenneemar: "levinyamin amar yedid Adonai yishkon lavetach alav", veyitkapperu bo yedidim – ellu yisrael, dichtiv: "natatti et yedidut nafshi bechaf oyveha".

Yavo tov vikabbel tov mittov lattovim. yavo tov – ze moshe, dichtiv: "vattere oto ki tov hu". vikabbel tov – zo tora, dichtiv: "ki lekach tov natatti lachem". mittov – ze hakkadosh baruch hu, dichtiv: "tov Adonai lakkol". lattovim – ellu yisrael, dichtiv: "hetiva Adonai lattovim".

Yavo ze vikabbel zot mizze leam zu – yavo ze – ze moshe, dichtiv: "ki ze moshe haish", vikabbel zot – zo hattora, dichtiv: "vezot hattora asher sam moshe", mizze – ze hakkadosh baruch hu, dichtiv: "ze eli veanvehu", leam zo – ellu yisrael, shenneemar: "am zu kanita".
Amar rabbi yitzchak: beshaa shecharav bet hammikdash, metzao hakkadosh baruch hu leavraham shehaya omed bevet hammikdash, amar lo: "me lididi beveti"?
Amar lo al iske banay bati, amar lo: banecha chatu vegalu, amar lo: shemma beshogeg chatu? amar lo: "asotah hammezimmata", amar lo: shemma miutan chatu? amar lo: "harabbim".
Haya lecha lizkor berit mila, amar lo: "uvesar kodesh yaavru mealayich", amar lo: shemma im himtanta lahem hayu chozrin bitshuva, amar lo: "ki raatechi az taalozi".

Miyyad hinniach yadav al rosho, vehaya tzoek uvoche, veamar lo: shemma chas veshalom en lahem takkana? yatzta bat kol veamra lo: "zayit raanan yefe feri toar kara Adonai shemech", ma zayit (zo) [ze] acharito besofo, af yisrael acharitan besofan.

"Lekol hamulla gedola hitztzit esh aleha verau daliyyotav", amar rabbi chinnana bar pappa: lekol millehen shel meraggelim nitroau daliyyotehen shel yisrael, deamar rabbi chinnana bar pappa: davar gadol dibberu meraggelim beotah shaa, "ki chazak hu mimmenu" – al tikre "mimmenu" ella "mimmennu", kivyachol, sheafillu baal habbayit eno yachol lehotzi kelav mishsham.

Matkef la rabbi chiyyay berabbi chinnana: hay "lekol hamulla gedola", "lekol milla" mibbaya leh! ella, amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu leavraham: kolcha shamati vechamalti alehem, ani amarti yishtabedu bearba malchiyyot, kol achat veachat keshiur arba malchiyyot.
Hasheta, kol chada vachada may difsik la. veikka deamri: ani amarti beze achar ze, achshav bevat achat.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: lamma nimshelu yisrael lezayit? lomar lecha: ma zayit en alav noshrin, lo bimot hachamma velo bimot haggeshamim, af yisrael en lahem betela olamit, lo baolam hazze velo baolam habba. veamar rabbi yochanan: lamma nimshelu yisrael lezayit? lomar lecha: ma zayit eno motzi shamno ella al yede ketita, af yisrael en chozrin lemutav ella al yede yissurin.
Rabbi meir omer: hasseor bode lahen mittochan umechammeytzan [vechulei]. may "chasera o yetera"?
Amar rav chisda: issat hasseor ave – nimtzet yetera middat haissaron, rakka – nimtzet chasera.
Sof sof, ki ka chayel leissaron ka chayel.
Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: lichmot shehen (hayta) meshaarinan.
Velishkol pureta minneh, velaychmetzeh meabbaray, velayteya venilusheh bahadeh? gezera, dilma ate leetoye mealma.
Tanu rabbanan: en machmitzin

a: Betappuchim. mishshum rabbi chanina ben gamliel amru: machmitzin. rav kahana matne la berabbi chanina ben teradyon.
Keman azla ha ditnan: tappuach sherisseko, unetano betoch haissa, vechimmetza – hare zo asura.
Keman? lema rabbi chanina ben gamliel hi, vela rabbanan? afillu tema rabbanan, nehi dechametz gamur la have, nukeshe miha have.
Amar rabbi ila: en lecha hakkasha likmitza yoter mimminchat chote. rav yitzchak bar avdimi amar: minchat chote megabbelah bammayim, ucheshera.
Lema beha ka mippalgi, demar savar: kemot shehen meshaarinan, umar savar: lichmot shehayu meshaarinan.
La, dechulle alma kemot shehen meshaarinan, uveha ka mippalgi: demar savar may "chareva"? chareva mishshemen, umar savar chareva mikkol davar.
Tenan hatam: besar haegel shennitpach, uvesar zekena shennitmaech, mishtaarin lichmot shehen.
Rav verabbi chiyyay verabbi yochanan amri: mishtaarin kemot shehen, shemuel verabbi shimon bar rabbi veresh lakish amri: mishtaarin lichmot shehen.
Metivi: besar haegel shello haya bo keshiur, vetafach veamad al keshiur – tahor lesheavar, vetame mikkan ulehabba!
Midderabbanan.
I hachi, ema sefa: vechen befiggul, vechen benotar. i amrat bishlama deorayyta, hayeynu deikka piggul venotar, ella i amrat derabbanan, piggul venotar bidrabbanan mi ikka?
Ema: vechen betumeat piggul, vechen betumeat notar.
Salka datach amena: hoil vetumeat piggul vetumeat notar derabbanan hi, kulle hay bidrabbanan la avud rabbanan, ka mashma lan.
Ta shema: besar zekena shehaya bo keshiur, vetzamak pachot mikkeshiur – tame lesheavar, vetahor mikkan ulehabba.
Amar rabba: kol hecha demeikkara hava beh, vehasheta let beh – ha let beh, vechol hecha demeikkara la hava beh vehasheta hava beh – midderabbanan.
b: Ki peligi, kegon shehaya bo keshiur vetzamak vechazar vetafach, demar savar: yesh dichuy beissura, umar savar: en dichuy beissura.

Umi ikka leman deamar deyesh dichuy beissurin? vehatnan: kevetza ochalin shehinnichan bachamma venitmaatu, vechen kezayit min hammet, kezayit min hannevela, vechaadasha min hashsheretz, uchezayit piggul, uchezayit notar, uchezayit chelev – tehorin, veen chayyayvin alehen mishshum piggul venotar vachelev.
Hinnichan baggeshamim vetafchu – temein, vechayyayvin alehem mishshum piggul venotar vachelev. teyuveta leman deamar yesh dichuy beissurin! teyuveta.
Ta shema: tormin teenim al haggerogrot, beminyan.
I amrat bishlama lichmot shehen meshaarinan – shappir, ella i amrat kemot shehen – have leh marbe bemaasrot.
Utenan: hammarbe bemaasrot – perotav metukkanim, vmaserotav mekulekalin.
Ella may lichmot shehen? ema sefa: gerogrot al hatteenim bemidda.
I amrat bishlama kemot shehen – shappir, ella i amrat lichmot shehen – marbe bemaasrot hu.
Ella, hacha bitruma gedola askinan, veresha beayin yafa, vesefa beayin yafa hi.
I hachi, ema sefa: amar rabbi elazar berabbi yose: abba haya notel eser gerogrot shebbammaktzua al tishim shebbakkalkalla, vei bitruma gedola, eser may avidteh?

Ella hacha bitrumat maaser askinan, veabba elazar ben gomel hu. detanya: abba elazar ben gomel omer: "venechshav lachem terumatchem" – bishte terumot hakkatuv medabber, achat teruma gedola veachat terumat maaser.
Keshem shetteruma gedola nittelet beomed uvemachshava, kach terumat maaser nittelet beomed

a: Uvemachshava, ma teruma gedola beayin yafa, af terumat maaser beayin yafa.

Uminna, amar rabbi elazar bar rabbi yose: abba haya notel eser gerogrot shebbammaktzua al tishim shebbakkalkalla. i amrat bishlama lichmot shehen amrinan – shappir, ella i amrat kemot shehen – batzar lehu.
Ki ata rav dimi, amar rabbi elazar: shane gerogrot, hoil veyachol lesholkan ulehachziran lichmot shehen.
Tanu rabbanan: tormin teenim al haggerogrot, bimkom shergilin laasot teenim gerogrot, velo gerogrot al teenim, vaafillu bimkom shergilin laasot teenim gerogrot.
Amar mar: tormin teenim al haggerogrot bimkom shergilin laasot teenim gerogrot. bimkom shergilin – in, bimkom sheen regilin – la.
Hechi dame? i deikka kohen, makom sheeno ragil – ammay la? vehatnan: mekom sheyyesh kohen torem min hayyafe!

Ella peshita delekka kohen, ema sefa: velo gerogrot al hatteenim, vaafillu bimkom sheragil laasot teenim gerogrot. vei delekka kohen, ammay la? vehatnan: mekom sheen kohen – torem min hammitkayyem! ella peshita deikka kohen.
Resha delekka kohen, sefa deikka kohen? in, resha delekka kohen, sefa deikka kohen.
Amar rav pappa: shema minna, dachakinan umokminan matnitin bitre tame, vela mokminan bitre tannae.

Mishna kol hammenachot nilloshot befoshrin, umeshammeran shello yachmitzu, veim hechmitzu sheyareha – over belo taase, shenneemar "kol hammincha asher takrivu laAdonai lo tease chametz", vechayyayv al lishatah, veal arichatah, veal afiyyaytah.
Gemara mena hane mille? amar resh lakish, deamar kera: "lo teafe chametz chelkam", afillu chelkam lo teafe chametz.
Vehay lehachi hu daata? hay mibbee leh lechidtanya: "lo
b: Teafe chametz" – ma talmud lomar? vahalo kevar neemar "lo tease chametz"! lefi shenneemar "lo tease chametz", yachol lo yehe chayyayv ella achat al kullam? talmud lomar: "lo teafe".
Afiyyay bakkelal hayata, lamma yatzat lehakkish eleha? ma afiyyay meyuchedet shehi maase yechidi, vechayyayvin aleha bifne atzmah, af ani avi lishatah vaarichatah.
Vechol maase yechidi shebbah, leetoye kittuf, shehu maase yechidi, vechayyayvin aleha bifne atzmah.
Anan mechelkam" kaamrinan.
Veema: kulleh lehachi hu daata?
Im ken, lichtov "chelkam lo teafe chametz", may "lo teafe chametz chelkam"? shamat minna tarte.

Veema: afiyyay, difrat ba rachamana, lichayyayv chada; inach lichayyayv chada akkullehu! mishshum dehave davar shehaya bakkelal veyatza min hakkelal lelammed, lo lelammed al atzmo yatza, ella lelammed al hakkelal kullo yatza.
Veema: "lo tease" – kalal, "lo teafe" – parat, kelal uferat – en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat; afiyyay – in, midde acharina – la.
Amar rabbi aftoriki: mishshum dehave kelal uferat hameruchakin ze mizze, vechol kelal uferat hameruchakin ze mizze – en danin otan bichlal uferat.

Metiv rav adda bar ahava, veamri la kedi: uchelal uferat hameruchakin ze mizze en danin otan bichlal uferat? vehatanya: "veshachat oto bimkom asher yishchat haola lifne Adonai chattat hu" – hechan ola nishchetet? batztzafon, af ze batztzafon.
Vechi anu mikkan lemedin? vahalo kevar neemar: "bimkom asher tishshachet haola tishshachet hachattat"! ha lema ze yatza? lekovo, sheim lo shachat oto batztzafon – pesalo.
Atta omer lechach yatzat, o eno ella shezze taun tzafon veen acher taun tzafon? talmud lomar "veshachat et hachattat bimkom asher yishchat et haola", ze bana av lechol chattaot shetteunot tzafon.
Tama dichtav rachamana "veshachat et hachattat", ha lav hachi hava amena shezze taun tzafon, veen acher taun tzafon. may tama?
Lav mishshum dehave kelal uferat, veaf al gav dimruchakin ze mizze, danin otan bichlal uferat.
Matkef la rav ashe: hay kelal uferat hu?! perat uchelal hu, venaasa kelal mosif al happerat, (veitrabbi) [veitrabbo] lehu kol mille.
Ella tanna, "oto" ka kashya leh, vehachi kaamar: o eno ella shezze taun tzafon veen acher taun tzafon, dichtav rachamana "oto".
Vehasheta denafka leh mivshachat et hachattat", "oto" lemaote may? lemaote (nachshon, veshachat, of, bappesach siman).
"Oto" batztzafon, veen sair nachshon batztzafon.
Salka datach amena: hoil veitrabbi leinyan semicha, litrabbe name leinyan tzafon, ka mashma lan.
Usemicha gufa menalan? detanya: "vesamach yado al rosh hassair" – lerabbot seir nachshon lismicha, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer:

a: Lerabbot seire avoda zara lismicha.
Matkef la ravina: tinach lerabbi yehuda, lerabbi shimon may ikka lememar?
Amar leh mar zutera bereh derav mari leravina: lerabbi yehuda name, may deitrabbi – itrabbi, may dela itrabbi – la itrabbi.
Vechi tema, i la maateh kera, hava amena tete bevinyan av, semicha gufa lishtok kera minneh vetete bevinyan av! ella, shaa middorot la yalfinan. hacha name, shaa middorot la yalfinan.
Ella, "oto" taun tzafon, veen hashshochet omed batztzafon.
Midderabbi achiyyay nafka! detanya: rabbi achiyyay omer: "veshachat oto al yerech hammizbeach tzafona", ma talmud lomar?

Lefi shemmatzinu bimkabbel, sheomed batztzafon umekabbel batztzafon, veim amad bedarom vekibbel batztzafon – pasul, yachol af ze ken? talmud lomar: "oto" – oto batztzafon, velo hashshochet tzarich lihyot omed batztzafon!

Ella, oto batztzafon, veen ben of batztzafon. salka datach amena: lete bekal vachomer mibben tzon – uma ben tzon shella kava lo kohen kava lo tzafon, ben of shekkava lo kohen – eno din shennikba lo tzafon?
Ma leven tzon, shekken kava lo keli.
Ella: "oto" batztzafon, veen pesach batztzafon. pesach midderabbi eliezer ben yaakov nafka.

Detanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: yachol yehe happesach taun tzafon? vedin hu, uma ola shella kava lah zeman bishchitatah kava lah tzafon, pesach shekkava lo zeman lishchitato – eno din shekkava lo tzafon!
Ma leola, shekken kalil!
Mechattat – ma lechattat shekken mechapperet al chayyayve charetot!
Measham – ma leasham shekken kodshe kadashim, mikkullehu name shekken kodshe kadashim.

Ella leolam kidkaamrinan meikkara, "oto" batztzafon, veen hashshochet batztzafon. udeka kashya lach midderabbi achiyyay nafka – derabbi achiyyay lav lemaote shochet batztzafon hu daata, ella hachi kaamar: en hashshochet betzafon, aval mekabbel batztzafon.
Mekabbel millakach" "velakach" nafka, "lakach" "velakach" la mashma leh.

Vechayyayv al lishatah, veal arichatah, veal afiyyaytah. amar rav pappa: afaah – loke shetayim, achat al arichatah, veachat al afiyyaytah. veha amrat: ma afiyyay meyuchedet shehi maase yechidi vechayyayvin aleha bifne atzmah?
La kashya, ha daaracha hu vaafa hu, ha daaracha chavreh vihayv leh vaafa.
Tanu rabbanan: bechor sheachazo dam, makkizin oto et haddam bimkom sheen osin bo mum, veen makkizin et haddam bimkom sheosin bo mum, divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: yakkiz, af bimkom sheosin bo mum, uvilvad shello yishchot al oto mum. rabbi shimon omer:
b: Af nishchat al oto mum. rabbi yehuda omer: afillu met – en makkizin lo et haddam.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba, amar rabbi yochanan: hakkol modim bimchammetz achar mechammetz shehu chayyayv, dichtiv "lo tease chametz" velo teafe chametz".
Bimsares acher mesares, shehu chayyayv, dichtiv: "umauch vechatut venatuk vecharut", im al koret hu chayyayv, al notek lo kol shekken? ella lehavi notek achar koret, shehu chayyayv.
Lo nechleku ella bemetil mum bevaal mum, rabbi meir savar: "kol mum lo yihye bo", verabbanan savri: "tamim yihye leratzon".
Verabbi meir name, hachtiv "tamim yihye leratzon"? hahu lemaote baal mum meikkara.
Baal mum meikkara – dikla bealma hu.
Ella, lemaote pesule hammukedashim leachar pidyonam, salka datach amena: hoil vaasiri begizza vaavoda, bemumam name (littasri) [littasru], ka mashma lan.

Verabbanan name, hachtiv: "kol mum lo yihye bo"? hahu mibbee leh lechidtanya: "vechol mum lo yihye bo" – en li ella shello yehe bo mum, minnayin shello yigrom lo al yede acherim, shello yanniach batzek o devela al gabbe haozen kede sheyyavo hakkelev veyittelennu? talmud lomar: "kol mum". amar "mum" veamar "kol mum".
Amar rabbi amme: hinniach seor al gabbe issa, vehalach veyashav lo, venitchammetza meeleha – chayyayv aleha kemaase shabbat. umaase shabbat ki hay gavvna mi michayyayv? vehaamar rabba bar bar chana

a: Amar rabbi yochanan: hinniach basar al gabbe gechalim – hippech bo chayyayv, lo hippech bo patur.
Amar rava: may "chayyayv" name dekaamar? kemaase tzali shel shabbat.

Gufa, amar rabba bar bar chana, amar rabbi yochanan: hinniach basar al gabbe gechalim, hippech bo – chayyayv, lo hippech bo – patur. hechi dame? illema dei la hippech beh la beshil – peshita! ella dei la mehappech leh name hava beshil, ammay la michayyayv?

La tzericha, dei la happech beh – hava beshil mitztzad echad kemaachol ben derosay, vechi mehappech beh – beshil mishshene tzedadin kemaachol ben derosay, veka mashma lan dechol mitztzad echad kemaachol ben derosay – la kelum hu.

Amar rava: veim nitzla bo kigrogeret mitztzad echad bimkom echad – chayyayv. amar leh ravina lerav ashe: bimkom echad – in, bishnayim o shelosha mekomot – la? vehatnan: hakkodeach kol shehu – chayyayv!
Hechi dame? illema bemakom echad, kol shehu lemay chaze? ella lav bishnayim o shelosha mekomot, dachazo letzeruf? la, leolam bemakom echad, dachazu levava deaklida.

Veikka deamri, amar rava: afillu bishnayim ushelosha mekomot. amar leh ravina lerav ashe: af anan name tenena – hakkodeach kol shehu chayyayv. hechi dame? illema bemakom echad – kol shehu lemay chaze? ella lav bishnayim ushelosha mekomot, dachaze letzeruf? la, leolam bemakom echad, dachazu levava deaklida.
Tanu rabbanan: illu neemar "asher takrivu laAdonai lo tease chametz", hayiti omer en li belo tease chametz ella kometz bilvad.
Mincha minnayin? talmud lomar "mincha". shear menachot minnayin? talmud lomar "kol hammincha".
"Asher takrivu laAdonai" – keshera, velo pesula. mikkan amru: hamechammetz et hakkeshera – chayyayv, veet happesula – patur.
Bae rav pappa: chimmetzah veyatzat, vechazar vechimmetzah – mahu? kevan deyatzat ippesila la beyotze, vechi hadar mechammetz la – la michayyayv ala mishshum mechammetz acher mechammetz.
O dilma, kevan dechimmetzah, pesul yotze la mahane bay, vechi hadar mechammetz la – michayyayv ala mishshum mechammetz acher mechammetz? teku.
Bae rav mari: chimmetzah berosho shel mizbeach, mahu? "asher takrivu" amar rachamana, veha akreva,
O dilma mechussar haketara kimchussar maase dame? teku.

Vehasheta denafka leh mikkol hammincha", "asher takrivu (laAdonai)" lema li? mibbee leh lechidtanya: "asher takrivu" – lerabbot minchat nesachim lechimmutz, divre rabbi yose haggelili. rabbi akiva omer: lerabbot lechem happanim lechimmutz.
Minchat nesachim? me ferot hem!
b: Ume ferot en machmitzin? amar resh lakish: omer haya rabbi yose haggelili, minchat nesachim megabbelah bemayim ucheshera.
Lechem happanim middat yavesh hi, ushemana leh lerabbi akiva deamar: middat yavesh lo nitkaddesha.

Shelach rabbi reuven mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: kach hi hatztzaa shel mishna, veefoch – "asher takrivu" lerabbot lechem happanim lechimmutz, divre rabbi yose haggelili. rabbi akiva omer: lerabbot minchat nesachim lechimmutz.
Veazda rabbi yochanan letameh, deamar rabbi yochanan: rabbi yose haggelili veechad mittalmide rabbi yishmael amru davar echad, umannu rabbi yoshiyya.
Detanya, "vayyimshachem vaykaddesh otam". rabbi yoshiyya omer: middat hallach nimshach ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz, middat yavesh nimshechu mibbifnim veen nimshechu mibbachutz.

Rabbi yonatan omer: middat hallach nimshechu mibbifnim, veen nimshechu mibbachutz, middot yavesh lo nimshechu kol ikkar. teda lecha shehare en mekaddeshot, dichtiv "mimmoshvotechem taviu lechem tenufa shetayim shene esronim solet tihyena chametz teafena bikkurim laAdonai". ematay hen "laAdonai"? leachar shenneefu.

Bemay ka mippalgi? "beotam". rabbi yoshiyya savar "otam" lemaote middat yavesh bachutz, verabbi yonatan savar middat yavesh chol hu, vela itzterich kera lemaote, ki itzterich kera lemaote middat lach mibbachutz.
Lema name rabbi akiva veechad mittalmide rabbi yishmael amru davar echad, umannu? rabbi yonatan, mishshum dela shavu bemiddat lach lahadade.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: veha ikka bisa, delach hu. amar leh: kegon shellash al gabbe katvulya.
I hachi, dekaamar leh rabbi yonatan: teda lecha shehare enah mekaddeshet, lema leh: kegon dechayyla beissaron dechol.

Hachi hasheta? bishlama bisa – la ketav rachamana deleeved bisa lemelash beh, ki lash la al gabbe katvulya – let lan ba. ella issaron, kevan deamar rachamana: aved issaron ucheyel beh – shavek issaron dekodesh vechayel beissaron dechol?!

Tanu rabbanan: minnayin lemaale mibbesar chattat, umibbesar asham, umibbesar kodshe hakkodashim, umikkodashim kallim, umimmotar haomer, umimmotar shete hallechem, umillechem happanim, umishsheyare menachot, shehu belo taase?
Talmud lomar: "ki chol seor vechol devash lo taktiru mimmennu ishshe laAdonai", kol shehu mimmennu laishshim hare hu beval taktiru.
Ushete hallechem velechem happanim, yesh mehen laishshim? vehatanya: yatzu shete hallechem velechem happanim sheen mehem laishshim!
Amar rav sheshet: en miggufo laishshim.
Ittemar: hammaale mikkullam al gabbe hakkevesh, rabbi yochanan amar: chayyayv, rabbi elazar amar: patur.
Rabbi yochanan amar chayyayv, detanya: "hammizbeach" – en li ella mizbeach, kevesh minnayin? talmud lomar "veel hammizbeach lo yaalu leratzon".
Verabbi elazar amar patur, may tama? deamar kera: "seor udevash ... korban reshit takrivu otam".
"Otam" – hu derabbi lecha kevesh kemizbeach, aval midde acharina – la.

a: Verabbi yochanan, hay "otam" may aved leh?
Mibbee leh lechidtanya: yachol yehe yachid mitnaddev umevi kayyotze bah nedava, vekore ani bah "motza sefatecha tishmor veasita"?
Talmud lomar "korban reshit takrivu", tzibbur amarti lecha, velo yachid.

Yachol lo yehe yachid mevi, sheeno mevi chovato kayyotze bah, aval yehe tzibbur mevi shemmevi chovato kayyotze bah? talmud lomar "otam", uma yesh lecha lehavi? shete hallechem min hasseor, uvikkurim min haddevash.

Ushete hallechem lo yikrevu nedava? vehatanya: im neemar "kol seor", lamma neemar "kol devash"? veim neemar "kol devash", lamma neemar "kol seor"? mippene sheyyesh basseor ma sheen baddevash, veyesh baddevash ma sheen bisor.
Seor huttar mikkelalo bammikdash, devash lo huttar mikkelalo bammikdash.

Devash huttar bishyare menachot, seor lo huttar bishyare menachot. ha mippene sheyyesh basseor ma sheen baddevash, veyesh baddevash ma sheen bisor, hutzerach lomar "kol seor", vehutzerach lomar "kol devash".
Seor dehuttar mikkelalo bammikdash, may nihu? lav shete hallechem dekarva nedava? amar rav amram: la, likrav immahem.
I hachi, bikkurim name, ditnan: haggozalot sheal gabbe hassallin hayu olot, vehassallim shebbeyadam nittanin lakkohanim. hanhu leatter bikkurim hu deatu.
Bae rame bar chama merav chisda: hammaale mibbesar chattat haof al gabbe hammizbeach, mahu?
Kol shemmimmennu laishshim, amar rachamana, vehay en mimmennu laishshim? o dilma kol sheshshemo korban, vehay name shemo korban? amar leh: kol sheshshemo korban, vehay name shemo korban.
Ketannae: rabbi eliezer omer: kol shemmimmennu laishshim, rabbi akiva omer: kol sheshshemo korban.
May benayyhu? amar rav chisda: besar chattat haof ikka benayyhu.
