Rav amar: log shemen shel metzora ikka benayyhu, detane levi: "kol korbanam" – lerabbot log shemen shel metzora.
Tanu rabbanan: "seor ... bal taktiru" – en li ella kullo, miktzato minnayin? talmud lomar: "chol". eruvo minnayin? talmud lomar: "ki chol".
May kaamar? amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: "seor bal taktiru" – en li ella kezayit, chatzi zayit minnayin? talmud lomar "kol", eruvo minnayin? talmud lomar "ki chol".
Rava amar: hachi kaamar – "seor bal taktiru" en li ella kometz, chatzi kometz minnayin? talmud lomar: "chol". eruvo minnayin? talmud lomar: "ki chol".
Bemay ka mippalgi? abbaye savar: yesh kometz pachot mishshene zetim,
b: Veyesh haketara pechuta mikkezayit.
Verava amar: en kometz pachot mishshene zetim, veen haketara pechuta mikkezayit.
Ittemar: hammaale misseor umiddevash al gabbe hammizbeach, amar rava: loke mishshum seor, veloke mishshum devash, loke mishshum eruve seor, umishshum eruve devash.
Abbaye amar: en lokin al lav shebbichlalot.
Ikka deamri: chada miha lake.
Veikka deamri, chada name la lake, deha la meyachad laveh kelav dachasima.

a: Mishna yesh teunot shemen ulevona, shemen velo levona, levona velo shemen, lo levona velo shemen.
Veellu teunot shemen ulevona: minchat hassolet, vehammachavat, vehammarcheshet, vehachallot, veharkikin.
Minchat kohanim, minchat kohen mashiach, minchat goy, minchat nashim, minchat haomer.
Minchat nesachim teuna shemen, veen teuna levona. lechem happanim taun levona, veen taun shemen.
Shete hallechem, uminchat chote, uminchat kenaot – en teunin lo shemen velo levona.
Gemara amar rav pappa: kol hecha ditnan eser – tenan, leappoke midderabbi shimon deamar: mechetza challot umechetza rekikin yavi, ka mashma lan dela.
Tanu rabbanan: "venatatta aleha shemen" – velo al lechem happanim shemen.

Sheyyachol – vahalo din hu: uma minchat nesachim sheenah teuna levona teuna shemen, lechem happanim shettaun levona – eno din shettaun shemen! talmud lomar "aleha" – aleha shemen, velo al lechem happanim shemen.
"Vesamta aleha levona" – aleha levona, velo al minchat nesachim levona.

Sheyyachol, vahalo din hu: uma lechem happanim sheeno taun shemen – taun levona, minchat nesachim shetteuna shemen – eno din shetteuna levona? talmud lomar "aleha" – aleha levona, velo al minchat nesachim levona.
"Mincha" – lerabbot minchat shemini lilvona, "hi" – lehotzi shete hallechem, shello yitanu lo shemen velo levona.
Amar mar: "aleha shemen" – velo al lechem happanim shemen. ema: "aleha shemen" – velo al minchat kohanim shemen!
Mistabbera minchat kohanim hava leh lerabboye, shekken issaron, keli,
Chutz, vetzura, haggasha,
Veishshim.
Adderabba, lechem happanim hava leh lerabboye, shekken tzibbura, chova, tamya.
Deachel piggula, beshabbeta.
Mistabbera "nefesh".
Amar mar: "aleha levona" – velo al minchat nesachim levona. ema: "aleha levona" – velo al minchat kohanim levona!
Mistabbera minchat kohanim hava leh lerabboye, shekken issaron balul belog.
Muggash, biglal etzem.
Adderabba, minchat nesachim hava leh lerabboye, shekken tzibbura,
Chova, veittammi. beshabbeta.
Mistabbera "nefesh".
"Mincha" – lerabbot minchat shemini lilvona, veema – lehotzi? hay may? i amrat bishlama lerabbot – shappir.
Ella i amrat lehotzi – lema li? shaa middorot la yalfinan.
"Hi" – lehotzi shete hallechem, shello yitanu lo shemen velo levona. veema lehotzi minchat kohanim? mistabbera minchat kohanim hava leh lerabboye, shekken issaron,
Keli, matztza, veetzem, haggasha, veishshim.
Adderabba,
b: Shete hallechem hava leh lerabboye, shekken: tzibbur, chova, tamya, daachal,
Piggula, beshabbeta, mattir, tenufa, baaretz,
Bizman chadash, vehane nefishan.
Mistabbera "nefesh".
Mishna vechayyayv al hashshemen bifne atzmo, vechayyayv al levona bifne atzmah. natan aleha shemen – pesalah, levona – yilketenna.
Natan shemen al sheyareha – eno over belo taase; natan keli al gabbe keli – lo pesalah.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "lo yasim aleha shemen", veim sam – pasal.
Yachol lo yitten aleha levona, veim natan – pasal? talmud lomar "ki chattat". yachol af beshemen? talmud lomar "hi".
Uma raita lifsol bashshemen ulehachshir ballevona? posel ani bashshemen, shei efshar lelokto, umachshir ani ballevona, sheefshar leloktah.
Bea rabba bar rav huna merabbi yochanan: natan aleha levona shechuka, mahu? mishshum deefshar leloktah, veha la efshar leloktah? o dilma mishshum dela mibbala, veha name la mibbala?
Ta shema: ulevona yilketenna.
Dilma chada veod kaamar: chada, dela mibbala, veod – yilketenna.
Ta shema: machshir ani ballevona, sheefshar leloktah. hacha name, chada veod ka amar.

May have ala? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: tanya, minchat chote uminchat kenaot shennatan aleha levona – melakket et hallevona, ucheshera. veim ad shello likket levonatah chishshev aleha, ben chutz lizmanno ben chutz limkomo – pasul, veen bo karet.
Veim mishshellikket levonatah, mechashshev aleha chutz limkomo – pasul, veen bo karet. chutz lizmanno – piggul, vechayyayvin alav karet.
Vetihve pach, veammay pasla bemachshava? dachuy hu!
Amar abbaye: "chattat" karyay rachamana. rava amar: ha manni? chanan hammitzri hu, delet leh dechuyin.
Detanya, chanan hammitzri omer: afillu dam bakkos, mevi chavero shello behagerala umezavvevg lo.
Rav ashe amar: kol shebbeyado – la have dachuy.

Amar rav adda: kevavteh derav ashe mistabbera, deman shamat leh deit leh dechuyin? rabbi yehuda hi, ditnan: veod amar rabbi yehuda: nishpach haddam – yamut hammishtalleach, met hammishtalleach – yishshafech haddam.
Veillu hecha divyado, tanya, rabbi yehuda omer: kos haya memalle middam hattaarovot, vezorko zerika achat keneged hayesod.
Amar rav yitzchak bar yosef, amar rabbi yochanan: natan mashshehu shemen al gabbe kezayit mincha – pasal. may tama? "lo yasim" – sima kol dehu, "aleha" – ad deikka shiura.
Veamar rav yitzchak bar yosef, amar rabbi yochanan: natan kezayit levona al gabbe mashshehu mincha – pasal. may tama? "lo yitten" ketiv, ad deikka netina. "aleha" –

a: Have ribbuy achar ribbuy, veen ribbuy achar ribbuy ella lemaet.
Veikka deamri, amar rav yitzchak bar yosef: bae rabbi yochanan: natan mashshehu shemen al gabbe kezayit mincha, mahu? mi baenan sima kintina o la? teku.
Natan shemen al sheyareha, tanu rabbanan: "lo yasim aleha shemen velo yitten", yachol bishne kohanim.
Talmud lomar "aleha", begufah shel mincha hakkatuv medabber, velo bechohen.
Yachol lo yitten keli al gabbe keli, veim natan – pasal? talmud lomar "aleha", begufah shel mincha hakkatuv medabber.
Mishna yesh teunot haggasha, veen teunot tenufa. haggasha utenufa. tenufa velo haggasha. lo tenufa velo haggasha.

Veellu teunot haggasha veen teunot tenufa: minchat hassolet, vehammachavat, umarcheshet, vehachallot, veharkikin, minchat kohanim, uminchat kohen mashiach, minchat goyim, minchat nashim, uminchat chote.
Rabbi shimon omer: minchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach en bahen haggasha, lefi sheen bahen kemitza, vechol sheen bahen kemitza en bahen haggasha.
Gemara amar rav pappa: kol hecha ditnan eser – tenan. may ka mashma lan?
Leappoke midderabbi shimon, deamar: mechetza challot umechetza rekikin yavi, ka mashma lan dela.
Mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: illu neemar "veheveta asher yease meelle laAdonai vehikrivah el hakkohen vehiggishah", hayiti omer: en li shettaun haggasha ella kometz bilvad.
Mincha, minnayin? talmud lomar "mincha". minchat chote minnayin? talmud lomar "et hammincha".
Vedin hu: neemar have
b: Minchat chova, veneemar have minchat nedava. ma minchat nedava teuna haggasha – af minchat chova teuna haggasha!
Ma leminchat nedava, shekken teuna shemen ulevona? minchat sota tochiach!
Ma leminchat sota shekken teuna tenufa? minchat nedava tochiach.

Vechazar haddin, lo rei ze chiri ze, velo rei ze kiri ze. hatztzad hashshave shebbahen – sheshshavu likmitza, veshavu lehaggasha. af ani avi minchat chote sheshshava lahen likmitza, tashve lahen lehaggasha!
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen, shekken hucheshru lavo beashir kivani, tomar beminchat chote shello hucheshra lavo beashir kivani? talmud lomar "et hammincha".

Rabbi shimon omer: "veheveta" – lerabbot minchat haomer lehaggasha, vechen hu omer: "vahavetem et omer reshit ketzirchem el hakkohen", "vehikrivah" – lerabbot minchat sota lehaggasha, vechen hu omer: "vehikriv otah el hammizbeach".
Vedin hu: uma minchat chote, sheenah teuna tenufa – teuna haggasha, minchat sota, shetteuna tenufa – eno din shetteuna haggasha! ma leminchat chote, shekken baa chittin!
Minchat haomer tochiach. ma leminchat haomer, shekken teuna shemen ulevona? minchat chote tochiach.

Vechazar haddin, lo rei ze kiri ze, velo rei ze kiri ze. hatztzad hashshave shebbahen, sheshshavu likmitza veshavu lehaggasha, af ani avi minchat sota sheshshavvta lahen likmitza – tishve lahen lehaggasha!
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen, shekken lo hucheshru lavo kemach, tomar minchat sota shehucheshra lavo kemach? talmud lomar "vehikrivah".
Rabbi yehuda omer: "veheveta" – lerabbot minchat sota lehaggasha, vechen hu omer: "vehevi et korbanah aleha".
Aval minchat haomer la tzericha kera, may tama? middina ka atya: uma minchat chote sheenah teuna tenufa – teuna haggasha, minchat haomer shetteuna tenufa – eno din shetteuna haggasha!
Ma leminchat chote shekken baa chittin? minchat sota tochiach. ma leminchat sota shekken baa levarer avon, demazkeret avon" hi! minchat chote tochiach.

Vechazar haddin, lo rei ze chiri ze, velo rei ze kiri ze, hatztzad hashshave shebbahen, shekken shavu likmitza, veshavu lehaggasha, af ani avi minchat haomer sheshshavvta lahen likmitza, tishve lahen lehaggasha.
Umay parchat? rabbi shimon parech hachi: ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen, shekken metzuyin.
Verabbi yehuda, adderabba, ha metzuyay tefe, hanach zimnin dela mashkachat la kelal.
O eno omer "veheveta" ella sheyyachid mitnaddev umevi mincha acheret, chutz meelle shebbainyan.

Vedin hu: tzibbur mevi mincha min hachittin chova, umevi mincha min hasseorin chova, af yachid shemmevi mincha min hachittin nedava – yachol yavi mincha min hasseorin nedava? talmud lomar "elle" – en li ella elle.
O eno omer "elle" ella laomer "hare alay mincha", shemmevi chamishtan? talmud lomar "meelle" – ratza achat mevi, ratza chamishtan mevi.
Rabbi shimon omer: "et hammincha" – lerabbot shear menachot, kegon minchat goyim minchat nashim, lehaggasha. yachol sheani merabbe af shete hallechem velechem happanim? talmud lomar "meelle".

Uma raita lerabbot shear menachot, ulehotzi shete hallechem velechem happanim? merabbe ani shear menachot, sheyyesh mehen laishshim, umotzi ani shete hallechem velechem happanim, sheen mehen laishshim.
Vahalo minchat nesachim kullah laishshim, yachol (yehe) [tehe] teuna haggasha? talmud lomar "vehikrivah".
Veha appekteh "vehikriv" "vehikrivah", uma raita lerabbot shear menachot ulehotzi minchat nesachim?

a: Merabbe ani shear menachot shebbaot biglal atzman, umotzi ani minchat nesachim sheenah baa biglal atzmah. vahalo minchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach baot biglal atzman, yachol yehu teunot haggasha?
Talmud lomar "vehiggishah". hay mibbee leh legufah, shetteuna haggasha! min "vehiggish" "vehiggishah".

Uma raita lerabbot shear menachot, ulehotzi minchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach? merabbe ani shear menachot, sheyyesh mehen laishshim, uvaot biglal atzman, veyesh mehen lakkohanim. umotzi ani shete hallechem velechem happanim, sheen mehen laishshim. uminchat nesachim sheenah baa biglal atzmah. uminchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach, sheen mehen lakkohanim.
"Veherim" – yachol bichli? talmud lomar: "veherim mimmennu bekumtzo", ma harama haamur lehallan bekumetzo, af harama haamur kan bekumetzo.
Mishna ellu teunot tenufa veen teunot haggasha: log shemen shel metzora, vaashamo, vehabbikkurim kedivre rabbi eliezer ben yaakov, veemure shalme yachid, vechaze vashok shellahen.
Echad anashim veechad nashim, beyisrael velo baacherim. shete hallechem ushene kivse atzeret.

Ketzad hu ose? noten shete hallechem al gabbe shene kevasim, umanniach shete yadav lematta, molich umevi, maale umorid, shenneemar: "asher hunaf vaasher huram". tenufa hayta bammizrach, vehaggasha bammaarav. tenufot kodmot lahaggashot.
Minchat haomer uminchat kenaot teunot haggasha utenufa. lechem happanim uminchat nesachim en teunot lo haggasha velo tenufa.
Rabbi shimon omer: shelosha minin teunin shalosh mitzvot, shetayim bechol achat veachat, ushelishit en bahen. veellu hen: zivche shalme yachid, vezivche shalme tzibbur, vaasham metzora.

Zivche shalme yachid – teunin semicha chayyim, utenufa shechutin, veen bahen tenufa chayyim. zivche shalme tzibbur – teunim tenufa chayyim ushechutin, [veen bahem semicha]. vaasham metzora – taun semicha utenufa chay, veen bo tenufa shachut.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "vehikriv oto leasham veet log hashshamen vehenif otam tenufa" – melammed shetteunin tenufa keechad.
Uminnayin sheim henif ze beatzmo veze beatzmo yatza? talmud lomar "vehikriv oto leasham vehenif". yachol yanif veyachzir veyanif? talmud lomar "tenufa", velo tenufot.
"Lifne Adonai" – bammizrach. veha amar: "lifne Adonai" – yachol bammaarav!
Amri: hane mille mincha, deikkeri "chattat", vechattat teuna yesod, vekeren deromit mizrachit lo haya lo yesod, aval hacha "lifne Adonai" karena beh.
Vehabbikkurim, kedivre rabbi eliezer ben yaakov. may rabbi eliezer ben yaakov? detanya: "velakach hakkohen", limmed al habbikkurim shetteunin tenufa, divre rabbi eliezer ben yaakov.
May tama derabbi eliezer ben yaakov? gamar yad yad mishshelamim, ketiv hacha "velakach hakkohen hattene miyyadecha", uchetiv hatam "yadav tevienna".
b: Ma kan kohen – af lehallan kohen, uma lehallan bealim af kan bealim. ha ketzad? kohen manniach yado tachat yede bealim umenif.
Velema name kedivre rabbi yehuda, detanya: rabbi yehuda omer: "vehinnachto" – zo tenufa, atta omer zo tenufa, o eno ella hannacha?
Keshehu omer "vehinnicho", hare hannacha amur; ha ma ani mekayyem "vehinnachto" – zo tenufa.
Amar rava: hoil ufatach bo hakkatuv techilla. rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: hoil verav guvreh.
Veemure shalme yachid, vechaze vashok shellahen – echad haanashim veechad hannashim, beyisrael aval lo baacherim. may kaamar?
Amar rav yehuda: hachi kaamar – echad anashim veechad nashim, korbanan taun tenufa, utenufa atzmah beyisrael, aval lo bide nashim.
Tanu rabbanan: bene yisrael menifin, veen haggoyim menifin. bene yisrael menifin, veen hannashim menifot.
Amar rabbi yose: matzinu shechillek hakkatuv ben korban yisrael lekorban goyim lekorban nashim bismicha, yachol nachlok bitnufa?
La, ma li chillek bismicha, shehassemicha bivalim.
Nachlok bitnufa, shehattenufa bechohanim, im ken ma talmud lomar "bene yisrael"? bene yisrael menifin veen haggoyim menifin, bene yisrael menifin veen hannashim menifot.
Tanya iddach: "bene yisrael" – en li ella bene yisrael, gerim vaavadim meshucherarin minnayin? talmud lomar "hammakriv".
O eno ella ze kohen hammakriv? keshehu omer "yadav teviena", hare bealim amur. ha ketzad? kohen manniach yadav tachat yede habbealim umenif.
